explanation: 该论文主要关注美国电力传输基础设施的投资成本和收益，涉及政策场景下的发电、输电和储能系统优化。虽然提到了排放影响，但没有涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析或气溶胶反演等。因此，与大气环境遥感技术没有强关联。
authors: Kamran Tehranchi;Trevor Barnes;Martha Frysztacki;Inês M L Azevedo
title: Costs and benefits of transmission investments in the United States under different policy scenarios
abstract: The United States faces the need to build generation and transmission infrastructure to meet a growing electricity demand. We assess the value, asset investments, and emissions impacts of building transmission, generation, and storage under varying policy scenarios. We model cost-optimal investments and operations for 2035 and 2050 by finding the minimum annualized total system costs for investments and operations of generation, transmission, and storage under a set of technical and policy constraints for a current policy scenario (CPS), a renewable tax credit scenario that assumes recently repealed tax credits remain in effect, and zero-emissions scenarios in which the U.S. electricity sector achieves zero CO2 emissions by 2050. We also explicitly report on the expenditures associated with production/investment tax credits to illustrate the private and gross public costs. Our key results are as follows: (i) investments in transmission infrastructure reduce system costs in all policy scenarios, albeit modestly under non-emissions constrained scenarios; (ii) large emissions reductions could be achieved even absent zero-emissions goals if tax credits/incentives for renewables are in place—indeed, we find that with renewable incentives in place, annualized system costs remain within 6% of the CPS, while reducing emissions by 46% even if no additional interregional transmission is built; (iii) generation cost reductions are driven by wind capacity investments across all scenarios; and (iv) where transmission is built matters: certain seams, such as those connecting the eastern interconnection to Electric Reliability Council of Texas and the western interconnections, are selected across all policy environments. Overall, our findings support the economic and emissions benefits that can be realized by planning investments in generation, transmission, and storage across the United States.

explanation: 该论文主要研究地下水的季节性补给阈值，尽管涉及降雨观测，但并未直接涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。
authors: M Shanafield;A Baker;M S Andersen;S C Priestley;W Timms;M L Melo Zurita
title: Seasonality defines groundwater recharge thresholds across Australia
abstract: Reliable prediction of groundwater recharge from rainfall is crucial to water management but is scientifically challenging. Previous studies have demonstrated that caves, mines, and tunnels provide useful ‘windows’ for observing rainfall recharge timing and thresholds (i.e. amount of rainfall in a given time period causing a change in dripping from the void ceiling). Using drip loggers at sites across the Australian continent, we find that annual median rainfall recharge thresholds (RRTs) are statistically similar across 16 sites. However, thresholds vary by season. In climates dominated by winter rainfall, recharge is highly unlikely to occur during summer and autumn, even for high volume rain events. Similarly, during drought years winter rainfall may not be sufficient to cause recharge, even for events where RRTs are met. Conversely, montane and summer-wet sites showed a more reliable recharge response to rain events above the RRT. This enhanced understanding of recharge dynamics should be considered in modeling aquifer dynamics and planning sustainable groundwater use.

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它探讨了室内空气质量监测和治理问题，提到了野火烟雾等大气污染物，并涉及了空气质量监测和标准制定的相关内容。
topic_words: ['indoor air quality', 'wildfire smoke', 'air quality monitoring', 'enforceable standards']
authors: Donna Green;Bronwyn King
title: Indoor air quality at the climate-health nexus: the case for enforceable standards
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic exposed a longstanding governance gap: most people spend much of their time indoors, yet indoor air quality remains far less regulated than outdoor air. Climate change is now worsening that gap by increasing the frequency and severity of wildfire smoke and heat-driven building closures, both of which degrade air quality in homes, schools, workplaces and other occupied spaces. Poor indoor air quality is therefore no longer only a building-performance issue; it is a climate-health problem with clear implications for infection control, chronic disease, cognitive performance and equity. The case for action is strengthened by growing evidence that the costs of inaction are substantial, while the benefits of better indoor environments are measurable. This perspective piece argues that indoor air quality should be governed through enforceable, performance-based standards with statutory force, beginning in settings where exposure is unavoidable and vulnerability is high. Australia is used as an illustrative case to show how monitoring, institutional responsibility and phased implementation could be built into a practical regulatory pathway.

explanation: 该论文研究了中国1961-2022年地表太阳辐射和日间温度变化，探讨了辐射变化对温度波动的影响，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和气候变化研究密切相关。
authors: Yujia Shi;Kaicun Wang;Yanyi He;Guocan Wu
title: Surface solar radiation and day-to-day temperature variability in China during 1961–2022: evidence from the dimming–brightening transition
abstract: Climate change affects natural and human systems not only through changes in mean temperature but also through rapid temperature fluctuations between consecutive days. Using homogenized daily mean and maximum temperature observations and reconstructed surface solar radiation at 1759 matched stations in China during 1961–2022, we evaluated the seasonal cycles, probability distributions, and long-term trends of day-to-day temperature variability (DTD and DTDMAX). The regression adjustment was applied to extract the fitted component of temperature anomalies that is statistically correlated with simultaneous radiation anomalies. The results show that, both of DTD and DTDMAX exhibited higher values in winter and spring than in summer and autumn, and the radiation-associated differences were stronger for DTDMAX. The distributions shifted leftward after regression adjusted for most river basins, with substantially larger distributional contrasts for DTDMAX than for DTD. The annual DTD and DTDMAX in most regions showed an interdecadal transition, which is highly consistent with ‘global dimming and brightening’. The increasing trends in DTD and DTDMAX during 1991–2022 were weaker in the regression adjusted series than in the original series, indicating that part of their long-term increase was statistically associated with contemporaneous solar radiation. The slope changed from 0.015 to −0.004 °C/10a for DTD, and from 0.049 to 0.001 °C/10a for DTDMAX in the Yangtze River Basin. After removing linear trends and controlling for annual precipitation, positive correlations with day-to-day radiation variability occurred in 81.28% of grid cells for DTD and 89.60% for DTDMAX. The results show that short-term thermal variability is associated with surface radiation variability, particularly for daily maximum temperature. These findings advance our understanding of short-term temperature variability across China, with meaningful implications for the climate related impacts and environmental risk under a warming climate.

explanation: 虽然该论文涉及交通和气候变化，但它主要关注电动自行车对交通里程（VMT）的影响，而不是大气环境远程传感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析。
authors: Christophe Roncato Tounsi;Ryan Powers
title: Can Class 3 e-bikes help meet California’s VMT and climate goals? A mobility-substitution screening
abstract: Transportation is California’s largest source of greenhouse gas emissions, and vehicle electrification alone does not reduce vehicle-miles traveled (VMT). This paper asks whether Class 3 e-bikes—pedal-assisted to 28 mph—could replace some of the intermediate-distance commutes that conventional bicycles rarely serve. Using 2024 LOCUS mobility data for Los Angeles County, we define an addressable commute band as weekday peak-period Motorized travel of 5–15 miles one way. This market contains 11.98 million passenger-miles per weekday, while conventional bicycles account for only about 0.3% of passenger-miles under the same filters. European speed-pedelec evidence shows that these distances are within routine operating range. Because LOCUS includes e-bikes within Motorized travel, the scenarios explicitly vary both the automobile share of that category and the share of Class 3 travel that actually replaces car travel. In the upper-bound full-substitution case, a 10% shift removes 283 million vehicle-miles and 101.6 ktCO2e per year. That is 5.6 times LA Metro’s published bikeway VMT benefit, mainly because the trips considered here are longer. Yet the same scenario removes only about 0.43% of modeled county passenger VMT, and the 30% stress test about 1.3%. Class 3 e-bikes are therefore a potentially important intermediate-distance option, but only one part of the much larger mobility transition required in California.

explanation: 该论文研究的是西风爆发事件的成因，涉及天气系统和大气波动，虽然不直接涉及空气污染监测或卫星遥感技术，但其研究的大气动力学过程与大气成分分析、气象观测等领域相关，因此可以认为与大气环境遥感技术有一定关联。
topic_words: ['westerly wind burst', 'Madden–Julian Oscillation', 'equatorial convective Rossby waves']
authors: Haihang Zheng;Tao Lian
title: Collective effects of synoptic processes and equatorial waves on the genesis of a strong westerly wind burst event in late 2023
abstract: A strong westerly wind burst (WWB) event that occurred from 6–16 November 2023 has been suggested to have substantially influenced the development of the strong 2023/24 El Niño, yet the mechanisms governing its genesis remain poorly understood. Our analysis indicates that the Madden–Julian Oscillation and equatorial convective Rossby waves jointly initiated the event, with the latter playing the dominant role. During the intensification phase, southerly anomalies associated with mid‐latitude low‐pressure systems in the Southern Hemisphere sharply reinforced the WWB, while an East Asian cold surge and Tropical Cyclone Mal further amplified it during its peak. Given the crucial role of WWBs on ENSO evolution, our findings suggest that accurate El Niño prediction by current climate models will remain difficult unless synoptic‐scale processes closely related to WWBs can be adequately simulated.

explanation: 该论文研究了高温对中国长江三角洲地区城市和农村地区地表臭氧的敏感性，使用了空气质量观测和简化化学模型，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Chang Su;Massimo Bollasina;James Weber;David Stevenson
title: Summertime ozone sensitivity to temperature in China: observational evidence and mechanistic attribution in urban and rural areas in the Yangtze River Delta region
abstract:
Hot weather can strongly increase surface ozone, a harmful air pollutant, but the reasons differ between urban and rural areas. We studied a large city and a nearby rural region in eastern China using air quality observations and simplified chemistry modelling. We found that heat-driven plant emissions dominate ozone increases in the city, while chemical nitrogen cycling is key in the rural area. Our results help identify heat-resilient air pollution control strategies under climate change. 
 As climate change increases frequency and intensity of hot extremes, understanding how elevated temperatures influence surface ozone (O3) across different chemical regimes is critical. We combine observations from summer 2022 in the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) with controlled United Kingdom Chemistry and Aerosols (UKCA) Box experiments for urban Shanghai and a lower-NOx, biogenically influenced Lishui regional environment. Observed daily-maximum O3 increases with temperature at both sites, with a stronger response in Shanghai. Two-dimensional T-RH distributions show that O3 rises with temperature and decreases with relative humidity (RH), implying that part of the temperature response is mediated by drying. Factorial box-model experiments separate the roles of temperature-driven shifts in chemical partitioning, diurnal thermal structure, temperature-dependent isoprene emissions, and humidity. In Shanghai, the increase in O3 between 30 and 40 °C is dominated by BVOC-driven chemistry, with temperature-amplified isoprene emissions explaining most of the observed response. In Lishui, O3 sensitivity is governed primarily by radical-NOx chemistry and thermal PAN-NOx cycling, with a much smaller role for BVOCs. Fixed RH scenarios substantially reduce the apparent contribution of “thermal chemistry”, highlighting humidity-dependent Ox loss and HOx-NOx cycling as key modifiers of the climate penalty. Because the 0-D framework excludes transport and meteorological dynamics, the reported fractions isolate the local chemical and emission-driven component of the O3-temperature relationship. Within this scope, the results identify robust regime-specific mechanisms linking heat, humidity, precursor chemistry, and surface O3 in the YRD and demonstrate the value of observation-constrained box models as a bridge to regional chemistry-climate simulations.

explanation: 该论文研究的是利用激光仪器（如卫星上的激光仪器）检测和测量沙漠扬起的矿物尘埃，这直接与大气环境遥感技术相关。论文探讨了尘埃在大气中的散射特性，以及如何通过理论分析改进卫星测量，这对于空气质量监测和大气成分分析具有重要意义。
topic_words: ['lidar', 'satellite measurements', 'dust aerosols', 'air quality monitoring', 'atmospheric composition analysis']
authors: Anthony La Luna;Zhibo Zhang;Qianqian Song;Hongbin Yu;John E. Yorks;Ping Yang
title: Asymptotic behavior of lidar scattering properties of absorbing dust aerosols across Rayleigh and geometrical-optics regimes: theory and implications
abstract:
Mineral dust blown from deserts affects air quality and climate worldwide. Scientists use laser instruments on satellites to detect and measure dust. We discovered that very large, iron-rich dust particles produce signals that fool these instruments into misidentifying them as pollution or smoke. Using light scattering theory, we showed this confusion follows universal physical laws regardless of dust shape – helping scientists better interpret next-generation satellite measurements. 
 Lidar ratio (S), linear depolarization ratio (δ), and single-scattering albedo (ω) are central quantities for dust typing and property retrieval in lidar remote sensing. We investigate their dependence on size parameter (x) and iron oxide fraction of mineral dust using TAMUdust2020 and triaxial-ellipsoid calculations. Results show a consistent asymptotic structure that is weakly sensitive to particle shape in both limits of scattering theory. In the Rayleigh limit (x≪1), S∝x-3 and ω∝x3, while δ remains small. In the geometrical-optics limit (x≫1), δ decreases toward low values and ω→1/2, whereas S increases because backscatter is reduced relative to extinction by strong absorption and diffraction-dominated scattering. These asymptotic constraints provide a unified physical interpretation of multiwavelength dust-lidar behavior and help explain observed spectral variability of dust depolarization and lidar ratio. A key implication is that large, strongly absorbing dust can produce optical signatures that overlap with weakly depolarizing aerosol classes, which may bias standard classification and inversion schemes toward underestimation of coarse and super-coarse dust contributions.

explanation: 该研究关注北极地区地表与大气之间的颗粒物交换，涉及空气质量和大气成分分析，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
topic_words: ['turbulent particle fluxes', 'High Arctic', 'eddy covariance', 'ice surfaces', 'blowing snow']
authors: Theresa Mathes;Ian Brooks;Sonja Murto;Michael Tjernström;Julia Kojoj;Paul Zieger;John Prytherch;Birgit Wehner;Andreas Held
title: Turbulent atmospheric particle fluxes in the High  Arctic: surface type dependence and variability
abstract:
The Arctic is warming faster than the global average, affecting key climate processes. We investigated the exchange of particles between the surface and the atmosphere in the High Arctic over a period of five weeks using eddy covariance measurements. While ice surfaces primarily act as a sink, strong winds can also cause particles to be released, a process likely linked to blowing snow. These results enhance our understanding of particle sources and facilitate more precise climate modelling. 
 The Arctic is warming at a significantly faster rate than the global average. This is altering the sources and sinks of aerosols, which influence the regional radiation balance and cloud formation. However, direct observations of turbulent particle fluxes over sea ice are scarce, limiting our understanding of the processes that control the exchange of aerosols between the surface and the atmosphere. During the ARTofMELT campaign in spring 2023, five weeks of continuous eddy covariance measurements of turbulent particle fluxes were conducted in the High Arctic to investigate particle sources and sinks over closed ice, leads, and open water. Overall, net particle deposition dominated, with median deposition fluxes of −0.02 (interquartile range −0.10 to 0.04) × 106 m−2 s−1 over closed ice. This confirms the role of ice surfaces as a particle sink under low to moderate turbulence. Under strong winds, net particle emission fluxes of up to 0.98×106 m−2 s−1 (95 % confidence interval excluding zero) were observed over closed ice surfaces, which are likely linked to processes involving blowing snow. A mixture of emission and deposition was observed over leads and open water surfaces. These observations highlight how surface heterogeneity and turbulence intensity can influence particle exchange in the High Arctic. As sea ice retreats and the extent of open water increases, local particle sources are expected to become more relevant to Arctic aerosol budgets and cloud processes. The results provide observational constraints on particle fluxes and may help to reduce related uncertainties in Arctic aerosol and climate model simulations.

explanation: 该论文研究了无人机垂直探测技术在行星边界层下部的应用，重点关注了辐射和混合层高度对垂直痕量物质分布的影响。研究涉及空气质量和大气成分分析，如CO2、O3、颗粒物浓度等，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Lasse Moormann;Friederike Fachinger;Holger Tost;Frank Drewnick
title: Influence of irradiance and mixing layer height on the vertical trace matter distribution in the lower planetary boundary layer – drone-based investigation
abstract:
Using drone-based vertical profiling, we a) compare the sensitivity of various meteorological and trace substances to detect mixing layer heights at night, b) investigate the dependency of the vertical trace matter distribution on irradiance and mixing layer heights and c) evaluate the representativity of ground-based measured variables for the lowermost troposphere and finally provide suggestions to enhance the representativity of ground-based measurement stations. 
 Drone-based atmospheric measurements allow time-resolved investigation of stratification in the lower atmosphere of many atmospherically relevant variables. Measuring a variety of variables can be used, e.g., for mixing layer (height, MLH) identification and examination of the representativity of ground-based measurements in the lowermost boundary layer. We present drone-based vertical profiling during two 2.5-week summer field campaigns in rural Germany to investigate the vertical distribution of trace matter and meteorological variables in the lowermost troposphere.Night-time vertical profiling of temperature, humidity, wind speed, and trace substances (CO2, O3, particle mass and number concentrations) in the lowest 120 m revealed a multiple-layer fine-scale stratification. Trace substances surpassed several traditional meteorological variables in sensitivity for MLH detection. Among all variables, O3 and potential temperature were the most reliable MLH markers, highlighting combining trace matter and meteorological measurements to understand stratification processes.Using a gradient-based approach for diurnal vertical profiles up to 500 m above ground, we evaluate under which conditions and to which degree ground-based measurements, used world-wide in networks or during individual field campaigns, can be taken as representative for the lowermost mixing layer, and how strong radiative-driven mixing reduces vertical gradients. Location-specific sources and sinks affect the trace matter distribution in the ML much stronger than irradiance. However, homogeneity of aerosol particle concentrations was strongly promoted under high-radiative conditions, even at low MLHs. This suggests distinguishing between high- and low-irradiation conditions in the planetary boundary layer could improve parameterization for vertical mixing and should be considered when evaluating ground-based data.

explanation: 该论文研究了平流层风（QBO）对高空云层的影响，使用了卫星观测和气候模型数据，涉及大气成分分析和云层变化，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Aleena M. Jaison;Paulo Ceppi;Sarah Wilson Kemsley
title: The role of the QBO for tropical high-cloud variability  in CMIP6 models and observations
abstract:
We investigate how stratospheric winds influence high clouds using satellite observations and climate models. These winds, known as the quasi-biennial oscillation, alter meteorological conditions in the troposphere such as upper-tropospheric temperature, stability, and humidity, and clouds respond to these changes. Reducing model biases requires improving cloud sensitivity to these factors. This framework could also help assess cloud responses to stratospheric cooling driven by climate change. 
 The Quasi-Biennial Oscillation (QBO) is a dominant mode of stratospheric zonal wind variability. Observations indicate that the QBO influences tropical phenomena such as convection, precipitation, and the Madden–Julian Oscillation, yet climate models often fail to capture these relationships. This study examines the QBO's impact on high clouds, in particular tropical tropopause layer clouds, in CMIP6 historical simulations and CALIPSO observations. Building on recent findings that identified relevant cloud-controlling factors (CCFs) for high clouds, we apply CCF analysis to assess QBO-driven changes in high-cloud amount and interpret these changes in terms of contributions from controlling factors. Our results confirm that the QBO westerly (QBOW) phase is associated with reduced tropical mean high-cloud cover. CMIP6 models successfully capture the reduction in tropical high clouds associated with QBOW, but with a weaker magnitude and strong inter-model spread. Among the analysed CCFs, upper-tropospheric temperature, static stability at 150 hPa and relative humidity contribute most to this reduction in observations, and to the model bias. The substantial model bias and spread suggest that better constraints on high-cloud sensitivity to upper-tropospheric thermodynamics are needed to improve simulated QBO-related cloud responses. This framework may also help assess cloud responses to climate change, including the role of greenhouse gas–driven stratospheric cooling.

explanation: 该论文研究了平流层/低热层中冰和人为烟尘颗粒的电静力学和碰撞动力学，这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，特别是涉及到空气质量和大气成分分析。研究内容涉及卫星发射对大气层的影响、颗粒聚集的形成机制等，这些都是遥感技术监测和分析的重要领域。
authors: Trinesh Sana;Sanjay K. Mishra;Ingrid Mann
title: Electrostatics and Collision dynamics of ice  and anthropogenic smoke particles in  the mesosphere/lower thermosphere
abstract:
The increase in satellite launches raises the anthropogenic influx of various elements into the Mesosphere and Lower Thermosphere (MLT), comparable to the natural meteoric influx. Aggregation of ice and space debris remnant in the MLT is studied using classical electrostatic approaches. Stable aggregate formation from ice and anthropogenic particle collisions has been established in the MLT region, which is found to be similar to that formed with meteoric smoke particles. 
 The increase in satellite launches raises the anthropogenic influx of various elements into the Mesosphere and Lower Thermosphere (MLT), comparable to the natural influx caused by meteoric ablation. This study investigates the electrostatic interactions between nano-meter-sized ice particles and remnants of space debris using a classical electrostatic framework. Aside from the Coulomb interaction, the attractive force between two particles at short distances, arising from polarization, is taken into account. Collision outcomes, the effective velocity regime for collisions, and the subsequent aggregation probability are estimated. Aggregation is limited to a specific range of collision velocities between minimum and maximum values. This range varies depending on factors such as particle size, mass density, and dielectric constant. For most particles, the velocity range of aggregation is from a few m s−1 to several tens of m s−1, where smaller particles may need significantly higher velocities to form stable aggregates. When considering the collisions of particles in thermal motion, it is found that Al2O3 (due to its greater abundance) and TiO2 (due to its higher dielectric constant), both originating from anthropogenic sources, may dominate in the formation of ice-anthropogenic particle aggregates. In the MLT region, the formation of stable aggregates from the collision of ice with particles from space debris, which one may denote as anthropogenic smoke particles (ASPs), is similar to that from collisions with meteoric smoke particles (MSPs).

explanation: 该论文研究的是单个柱模型中中国三个代表性区域的夏季降水日变化对对流触发和闭合处理的敏感性，涉及大气环流和降水模拟，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关，因为它关注降水过程的模拟和改进，这对于理解大气环境变化和监测空气质量至关重要。
topic_words: ['single-column model', 'convective trigger', 'closure treatments', 'diurnal precipitation cycle', 'atmospheric modeling']
authors: Xiaocong Wang;Yanjie Liu;Yimin Liu
title: Sensitivity of the summertime diurnal precipitation cycle over three representative regions of China to convective trigger and closure treatments in a single-column model
abstract:
This study advances our understanding of the representation of the diurnal cycle of precipitation (DCP) in numerical models. By systematically comparing three convection schemes with different trigger and closure treatments using a single-column model, this study identifies the physical mechanisms responsible for these biases and evaluates the effectiveness of various modifications in improving DCP simulations over China. 
 Using a single-column model, we investigate how trigger and closure treatments in ZM, TDK, and UNICON convection schemes affect the diurnal cycle of precipitation over China. For late-afternoon rainfall, TDK and ZM schemes with standard CAPE closure simulate precipitation peaks around noon, substantially earlier than observed. The UNICON scheme, with cold-pool feedback deactivated, also produces a noontime peak. For nocturnal rainfall, all schemes spuriously produce a noontime peak, in stark contrast to the observed nocturnal maximum. These behaviors are closely related to closure assumptions and the resulting cloud-base mass flux, which is primarily governed by CAPE in ZM and TDK, and responds more directly to surface fluxes in UNICON. By accounting for the imbalance between deep convection and boundary-layer production through specific modifications: adopting the dCAPE trigger in ZM, activating cold-pool feedback in UNICON, and applying the non-equilibrium closure in TDK, the simulated afternoon precipitation is delayed and in better agreement with observations. In addition, allowing elevated convection in ZM and UNICON improves nocturnal rainfall. The improved diurnal cycle is also evident in the diabatic heating fields. All modifications lead to a delayed and more pronounced upward-tilting heating structure as a result of the suppression of early-afternoon convection, with ZM and TDK extending to higher altitudes, while both intensified and extended in UNICON. These changes alleviate the upper-level cold bias in TDK and ZM. In UNICON, however, the overly strong convection reverses the upper-tropospheric bias from cold to warm with stronger magnitude, thereby worsening the bias.

explanation: 该论文研究了使用三频雷达进行雨滴大小分布反演的技术，这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，特别是与降水监测和大气成分分析相关。
authors: Liang Feng;Jiefan Yang;Zeyong Guo;Jiming Sun;Yue Sun;Huiling Yang;Xiangfeng Hu
title: The proof-of-concept for raindrop size distribution retrieval using combined dual-frequency radar DFR
abstract:
The dual-frequency radar can retrieve raindrop size distribution but causes ambiguity between dual-frequency ratio and raindrop diameter for small drops. To solve this, our study added a third radar frequency, using scattering simulations based on real raindrop observations. We established clear links between different dual-frequency ratio and raindrop size. Results show the ambiguity is greatly reduced and our method outperforms conventional ones, especially in light rain detection. 
 Accurate retrieval of raindrop size distributions (DSDs) is essential for understanding cloud and precipitation microphysics. The dual-frequency ratio (DFR) measured by dual-frequency radars is independent of the normalized intercept parameter (Nw) and depends solely on the mass-weighted mean diameter (Dm). This characteristic makes DFR a powerful parameter for DSD retrieval. However, the DFR–Dm relationship is subject to a dual-solution ambiguity, particularly for smaller particles. This study demonstrates that W-band reflectivities obtained through scattering simulations based on measured raindrop size distributions, combined with the DFR(Ka, W) constraint, effectively mitigate the DFR(X, Ka)–Dm dual-solution ambiguity. The results demonstrate that incorporating the DFR(Ka, W) constraint substantially reduces the DFR–Dm ambiguity, raising the proportion of data with a unique Dm solution from 35.38 % (DFR(X, Ka) alone) to 87.5 %. The proposed framework shows potential advantages over conventional approaches, particularly for weak echoes (< 20 dBZ), where conventional methods fail but the proposed framework maintains robust accuracy. This proof-of-concept study provides a reference framework for future three-frequency radar DSD retrieval.

explanation: 该论文研究了基于单波长偏振激光雷达的CONIOPOL算法，用于实时识别气溶胶和水汽，这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关。文中详细描述了该算法在比利时CL61观测站的应用，并与其他数据（如CAMS）进行了对比，显示了其在操作监测和长期气溶胶气候学中的潜力。
authors: Quentin Laffineur;Alexander Mangold;Andy W. Delcloo
title: New operational perspective to identify aerosols and hydrometeors in real-time with a pioneering algorithm (CONIOPOL) based on single-wavelength polarization lidar (CL61)
abstract:
CONIOPOL (CONIOlogy + POLarization) is a new algorithm for continuous, real-time classification of aerosols and hydrometeors using a single-wavelength polarization-enabled automatic lidar. Applied to one year of CL61 observations in Belgium, it provides physically consistent aerosol typing and seasonal patterns. Comparisons with CAMS (Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service) and sensitivity tests support its potential for operational monitoring and long-term aerosol climatology. 
 Air quality monitoring and climate studies require continuous, vertically resolved observations to characterize aerosols and their impact on radiation, cloud microphysics, and atmospheric composition. In this study, we present CONIOPOL (CONIOlogy + POLarization), an automated depolarization-based classification algorithm developed with the polarized Automatic Lidar Ceilometer (ALC), CL61 (Vaisala Oyj, Finland). The algorithm combines volume linear depolarization ratio (VDR), attenuated backscatter (ATB), and cloud-base height (CBH) retrievals to distinguish between aerosols, cloud phase, and precipitation, and to further classify aerosol subtypes.One full year (February 2024–January 2025) of observations collected at Uccle (Belgium) was analyzed to investigate the seasonal and vertical distributions of the identified atmospheric targets. Aerosol classifications were assessed through a conditional comparison, using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) Global Forecast products. CONIOPOL successfully identified dust, smoke/marine, continental, and mixed aerosol environments showing strong temporal and vertical correspondence with CAMS, in particular for transported mineral dust and smoke plumes.Despite its spectral limitations, the single-wavelength polarization-enabled ALC allows continuous, high-resolution aerosol classification over extended periods, providing a consistent observational dataset for investigating the seasonal evolution of aerosol types over mid-latitude Europe. These findings underscore the potential of polarization-enabled ALCs for long-term aerosol climatology and air quality monitoring, bridging temporal gaps between satellite, in situ, and multi-wavelength lidar observations.

explanation: 该论文研究利用卫星图像（MODIS Aqua）监测中国和美国海岸的水文条件，重点关注大气校正技术以提高遥感反射率（Rrs）产品的质量。由于海岸带大气条件和水质复杂，准确的大气校正对于获取可靠的数据至关重要。因此，该研究紧密关联大气环境遥感技术，特别是空气质量监测和水质遥感分析。
topic_words: ['Remote sensing reflectance', 'atmospheric correction', 'MODIS Aqua', 'coastal water conditions']
authors: Shuhui Zhao;Youlv Wu;Jingning Lv;Dan Zhao;Yan Zheng;Lian Feng
title: High-quality remote sensing reflectance  products over China and US coast
abstract:
We created a 20-year dataset tracking coastal water conditions in China and the United States using satellite images. By improving how the satellite data are processed in areas with complex atmospheric conditions and diverse water properties, we produced more reliable and complete observations. This helps researchers better monitor environmental changes and water quality along coasts that are often difficult to study. 
 Remote sensing reflectance (Rrs) is fundamental for deriving bio-optical properties of global surface waters. However, accurate atmospheric correction (AC) to derive Rrs in coastal waters remains challenging due to strongly absorbing aerosols and complex water optics. To address this, we developed an improved processing framework that integrates flexible use of global gridded aerosol models better suited for coastal environments and incorporates tailored masking strategies. Based on this framework, we generated a high-quality Rrs dataset from Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Aqua observations, spanning 2003–2022 for the coastal waters of China and the United States (US) – two regions where complex water optics and frequent anthropogenic aerosols have long impeded retrieval accuracy and valid data yield. Compared to the NASA standard MODIS Aqua Rrs products, the improved framework achieved a significant reduction in systematic bias. Multiple validation metrics support this, with the restoration of the mean regression slope to unity (1.00 ± 0.08 vs. 0.90 ± 0.06) across eight bands being the most prominent. Performance gains are particularly pronounced in the 488–555 nm range, which is most relevant to water color applications. The new dataset also yields significantly more valid retrievals, with regional mean increases of 56 % in the Chinese coastal waters and 18 % in the US coastal waters at 443 nm. Furthermore, it recovers fine-scale features in turbid waters and captures long-term dynamics, demonstrating its robustness for coastal monitoring. As a complementary resource optimized for estuaries, bays, and turbid coastal regions, the new dataset fills a critical gap in the ocean color data portfolio where standard products are less reliable. The dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16413443 (Zhao et al., 2025).

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它专注于研究海洋光学性质的光谱吸收系数，这些系数对于分析大气成分、气溶胶和海洋颜色等遥感应用至关重要。论文中提到的CoASTS和BiOMaP项目旨在通过现场测量支持海洋颜色应用，这与空气质量监测和卫星观测等领域高度相关。
topic_words: ['hyperspectral absorption coefficients', 'optically significant constituents', 'oceanographic Tower', 'Apparent and inherent optical properties']
authors: Jean-François Berthon;Giuseppe Zibordi
title: Coastal Atmosphere & Sea Time Series (CoASTS) and Bio-Optical mapping of Marine optical Properties (BiOMaP): the hyperspectral absorption coefficients by optically significant constituents
abstract:
The Coastal Atmosphere & Sea Time Series (CoASTS) and the Bio-Optical mapping of Marine optical Properties (BiOMaP) programs were conceived to support ocean color applications with field measurements of apparent and inherent optical properties. This work focusses on CoASTS and BiOMaP hyperspectral absorption coefficients of optically significant constituents as determined applying standardized instruments, community measurement methods, quality control schemes and consolidated processing codes. 
 The Coastal Atmosphere & Sea Time Series (CoASTS) and the Bio-Optical mapping of Marine optical Properties (BiOMaP) programs were conceived and implemented to assist ocean color applications with field measurements of apparent and inherent optical properties, as well as concentration of optically significant water constituents. The CoASTS program led to the creation of time-series of bio-optical measurements at the “Acqua Alta” Oceanographic Tower (AAOT) site in the northern Adriatic Sea continued from 1995 up to 2016. The BiOMaP program supported the collection of equivalent bio-optical measurements across European Seas from 2000 up to 2022. This work focusses on CoASTS and BiOMaP hyperspectral absorption coefficients of optically significant constituents as determined applying standardized instruments, community measurement methods, extended quality control schemes and consolidated processing. The work, which complements a previous one by Zibordi and Berthon (2024) centred on multi-spectral data, presents the CoASTS and BiOMaP hyperspectral absorption coefficients of pigmented and non-pigmented particles in the 400–750 nm interval, and colored dissolved organic matter in the 350–680 nm one, both with a 3 nm spectral resolution at 2 nm increment. The data are available at https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.993510 (Berthon and Zibordi 2026).

explanation: 该论文主要关注的是农业领域中的氮输入数据集，虽然氮的输入与大气环境有一定关联（例如氮氧化物是大气污染物），但论文的核心内容并未涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。
authors: Wensu Hao;Hanqin Tian;Hao Shi;Xing Yu;Naiqing Pan;Shufen Pan;Francesco N. Tubiello;Wulahati Adalibieke;Martial Bernoux;Philippe Ciais;Federico Maggi;Kazuya Nishina;Aimable Uwizeye;Feng Zhou
title: HaNi-Crop: A Harmonized and Gridded Global Dataset of Crop-Specific Nitrogen Inputs from Nitrogen Fertilizer and Manure
abstract:
HaNi-Crop dataset presents a long-term global dataset of nitrogen inputs from synthetic fertilizers and animal manure for different crops from 1961 to 2023. Built by combining agricultural statistics with crop distribution information, the dataset reveals how nutrient use has changed over time and provides a valuable resource for improving food production, environmental protection, climate change, and more sustainable agricultural management. 
 Crop-specific dataset on nitrogen (N) inputs from synthetic fertilizer and manure are critical for assessing crop productivity, nutrient use efficiency, and environmental impacts, as crops differ substantially in their N demands and utilization. However, existing datasets remain limited in their simultaneous coverage of crop-group specificity, spatial resolution, long-term temporal coverage, and fertilizer-form differentiation. These limitations have constrained comprehensive global and regional assessments of crop-specific greenhouse gas emissions, N use efficiency, N budgets, and agrifood-system resilience. Based upon the History of Anthropogenic Nitrogen Inputs (HaNi) data infrastructure (Tian et al., 2022), we present HaNi-Crop, a harmonized global dataset of crop-specific N inputs from synthetic fertilizer and manure for 21 major crop groups at a spatial resolution of 0.1° × 0.1°, spanning the period of 1961–2023. This dataset integrates national and sub-national fertilizer and manure statistics, crop harvested-area maps, fertilizer product information, and spatial allocation procedures to generate annual gridded estimates of crop-specific N application rates differentiated by NH4+-N and NO3--N forms. Globally, synthetic fertilizer N inputs to cropland increased sharply from 11 Tg N yr-1 in the early 1960s to more than 100 Tg N yr-1 by 2023, while manure N inputs increased from 14 to 23 Tg N yr-1. Throughout 1961–2023, three major cereal crops–wheat, maize, and rice, consistently accounted for approximately half of global synthetic fertilizer N inputs. Among N fertilizer forms, NH4+-N inputs increased from 8 to nearly 90 Tg N yr-1, while the inputs for NO3--N fertilizers only increased from 3 to about 12 Tg N yr-1. Overall, the HaNi-Crop dataset provides a critical foundation for crop-specific greenhouse gas accounting, Earth system and agroecosystem modeling, and N budget analyses to enhance food security, environmental sustainability, and climate mitigation. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21364978 (Hao et al., 2026).

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它使用遥感数据和森林调查数据开发了30米分辨率的树密度数据集，以监测中国森林和非森林地区的长期变化。这有助于研究森林动态、生态系统变化和土地管理，这些都与大气环境质量和碳循环密切相关。
authors: Ziyi Xian;Zhen Yu;Jinge Yu;Shirong Liu
title: ChinaTD30: An annual 30 m tree density dataset for China (1985–2022)
abstract:
We developed an annual 30 m tree-density dataset for China from 1985 to 2022 using national forest inventory observations and multi-source remote sensing data. The dataset captures long-term changes in tree density across forest and non-forest areas and provides uncertainty estimates, supporting studies of forest dynamics, ecosystem change, and land management. 
 Accurate information on tree density and its long-term dynamics is essential for understanding forest demography, ecosystem restoration, and terrestrial carbon cycling. However, existing tree-density products for China are generally limited by coarse spatial resolution, restricted temporal coverage, or a focus only on forested areas. Here, we developed a 30 m tree density dataset for China (ChinaTD30) spanning 1985–2022 by integrating four cycles of the National Forest Inventory (NFI), each comprising 670,279 plot observations, with long-term satellite observations, forest attributes, land-cover information, and environmental variables. Three modelling strategies were evaluated to balance prediction accuracy and temporal consistency, and a temporally unified model was adopted for the reconstruction of the released product. The resulting dataset characterizes tree density in both forest and non-forest ecosystems and resolves substantial spatial heterogeneity across China. Comparison with existing tree-density products showed large discrepancies in densely forested regions, partly reflecting differences in training data, spatial resolution, and model structure. The reconstructed time series reveals a pronounced long-term increase in China’s tree population. Forest trees increased from approximately 106 billion in 1985 to about 182 billion in 2022, an increase of approximately 72 %, while trees outside forests increased from about 2.3 billion to 5.1 billion. Tree number increases were evident not only across northern restoration regions but also in densely forested southeastern China. Tree density exhibited distinct age-related patterns between natural and planted forests, with densities generally peaking in youngto-middle-aged stands before declining in older stands. This dataset provides a spatially detailed and temporally consistent basis for investigating forest dynamics, ecological restoration, tree mortality, carbon cycling, and the contribution of trees outside forests across China. The dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23100944 (Xian et al., 2026a), with the nine associated part records detailed in the Data availability section.

explanation: 该论文研究的是在地球系统模型中更新极地平流层云参数化方案，并使用CALIOP和MLS卫星观测数据进行评估。极地平流层云是大气环境的重要组成部分，CALIOP和MLS是用于大气成分和云观测的关键卫星传感器。因此，该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Isabelle Sangha;Nathan L. Abraham;Andrew Orr;Hua Lu;Michael C. Pitts;Lamont R. Poole;Michael Weimer
title: Assessment of an updated polar stratospheric cloud parameterisation for the UK Earth System Model (UKESM1.1) within the UK Met Office Unified Model (v13.9) using  CALIOP and MLS observations
abstract:
The UK Earth System Model is updated with an improved polar stratospheric cloud scheme. The performance of the scheme is evaluated against satellite data. While the model fails to form the full range of observed ice, the scheme improves its ability to represent different polar stratospheric cloud types and their variations. This brings the model closer to satellite observations and highlights the need for further development to capture the polar stratospheric clouds with high number densities. 
 Accurately representing polar stratospheric clouds (PSCs) in global Chemistry-Climate Models and Earth System Models is important as they play a key role in springtime ozone depletion in polar regions by activating both chlorine and bromine species through heterogeneous reactions and denitrifying the stratosphere. Here, we present and evaluate an updated PSC parameterisation scheme implemented in the UK Earth System Model (UKESM1.1). The scheme includes the kinetic formation of nitric acid trihydrate (NAT) particles, the formation of supercooled ternary solution (STS) droplets assuming thermodynamic equilibrium, and accounts for ice and sulphate aerosols. To evaluate the new scheme, we compare modelled PSC production with satellite observations from the Cloud-Aerosol and Lidar with Orthogonal Polarization (CALIOP) instrument and model concentrations of gas-phase nitric acid, water vapour, and ozone concentrations with observations from the Aura Microwave Limb Sounder (MLS) instrument for the extended 2008 Antarctic and 2009/2010 Arctic winters. In comparison with the current, simpler scheme, the updated parameterisation increases both the range of PSC types that form and the seasonal variability, resulting in better agreement with CALIOP observations. However, there is still a gap in the model's ability to simulate ice PSCs with the full range of optical properties observed by CALIOP. The new scheme also slows the growth of NAT particles and enables nitric acid partitioning between gas, liquid, and solid phases, leading to improved agreement with gas-phase nitric acid MLS observations, although a substantial low-bias is still present in all model simulations. However, there is comparatively little impact on stratospheric ozone, with the exception near the edge of the polar vortex where the new scheme improves comparisons with MLS observations.

explanation: 该论文主要关注的是使用GPU进行高速地质动力学模拟，特别是求解Stokes方程。虽然计算大气环境的某些模型也会用到类似的数学方法（如流体动力学），但论文本身并未涉及大气环境远程传感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。因此，它与大气环境遥感技术的关联性不强。
authors: Kyeong-Min Lee;Deok-Kyu Jang;Cedric Thieulot;Byung-Dal So
title: High-performance geodynamics on GPUs using  the PETSc CUDA backend (GAUZZ v1.0.0)
abstract:
Geodynamic simulations of mantle flow repeatedly solve the Stokes equations at high memory and computational cost. We developed a Stokes solver for graphics processing units by coupling two open-source libraries. A single graphics processing unit solved the Stokes equations 6–11 times faster than a 32-core central processor, with the same accuracy. Two units further shortened the solution time of large problems. The doubled memory extended the maximum size of three-dimensional simulations. 
 GPUs provide much higher memory bandwidth than CPUs. Data-parallel computations with regular memory access patterns exploit the GPU architecture efficiently. To solve the Stokes equations, we apply a preconditioned conjugate-gradient (PCG) method to the Schur complement system. The algorithm is dominated by sparse matrix-vector products, vector inner products, vector updates, and repeated velocity subproblem solves, all of which map onto GPU architectures. We implement the solver in GAUZZ v1.0.0 on GPUs by coupling CUDA-enabled PETSc with FEniCS. PETSc AIJCUSPARSE matrices with CUDA vectors keep operators and field vectors resident in VRAM, which limits CPU-GPU transfers. The P1 mass matrix, the gradient operator, and the divergence operator are reused in the pressure-correction L2-projection step. HYPRE BoomerAMG was adopted for preconditioning the velocity-only subproblem. Accuracy and performance are evaluated on a manufactured solution, the SolCx benchmark, the sticky-air benchmark, 2D Rayleigh–Taylor instabilities, 3D thermo-mechanical convection, and a 2D subduction model with nonlinear viscosity. We confirm that the GPU-based implementation reproduces CPU solutions. Performance is quantified by the execution time of the pressure-correction step and by throughput, defined as the number of Stokes degrees of freedom divided by the execution time of one Stokes solve. A single GPU delivers 6–11× the throughput of a 32-core CPU across the Stokes benchmarks. Two GPUs increase the throughput at sufficiently large problem sizes, reaching up to 2.1× the single-GPU throughput. The two-GPU configuration also extends the maximum problem size to 2.5×107 DOFs, beyond the 48 GB VRAM limit of a single GPU.

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它主要研究如何通过GPU加速技术优化空气质量模型中的对流模块性能，旨在提高空气质量管理效率。论文涉及的关键技术包括GPU计算、异构计算集群并行化、以及大气过程集成与耦合社区模型（EPICC-Model），这些都是大气环境遥感技术的重要应用领域。
authors: Kai Cao;Qizhong Wu;Xiao Tang;Jinxi Li;Xueshun Chen;Huansheng Chen;Wending Wang;Huangjian Wu;Lei Kong;Jie Li;Jiang Zhu;Zifa Wang
title: Enhancing the advection module performance in the EPICC-Model V1.6.0 via GPU-HADVPPM4HIP V1.0 coupling and GPU-optimized strategies
abstract:
This study achieves significant acceleration by developing an optimized advection module for Emission and atmospheric Processes Integrated and Coupled Community Model on Graphics Processing Unit. Through implementing thread-block indexing, minimizing Central Processing Unit and Graphics Processing Unit communication, and an parallel framework, we demonstrate speedups: 556.5× faster offline performance for the Heterogeneous Interface advection solver and 20.5× acceleration in coupled simulations. 
 The rapid development of Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) has established new computational paradigms for enhancing air quality modeling efficiency. In this study, the heterogeneous-compute interface for portability (HIP) was implemented to parallel computing of the piecewise parabolic method (PPM) advection solver (HADVPPM) on China's domestic GPU-like accelerators (GPU-like), resulting in a GPU-accelerated version denoted as GPU-HADVPPM4HIP V1.0. Computational performance was enhanced through three strategic optimizations: reducing the central processing unit (CPU) and GPU (CPU-GPU) data transfer frequency, thread-block coordinated indexing, and the Message Passing Interface (MPI) and HIP (“MPI+HIP”) hybrid parallelization across heterogeneous computing clusters. Following validation of the GPU-HADVPPM4HIP V1.0 program's offline computational consistency and the pollutant simulation performance of the Emission and atmospheric Processes Integrated and Coupled Community version 1.6.0 (EPICC-Model V1.6.0) on the Earth System Numerical Simulation Facility (EarthLab), comprehensive performance testing was conducted. Offline benchmark results demonstrated that, for a one-dimensional input array containing 108 double-precision floating-point values, GPU-HADVPPM4HIP V1.0 compiled with the −O3 optimization option achieved a maximum speedup of 556.5× on a GPU-like accelerator relative to the Fortran HADVPPM implementation compiled with the −O0 option as the baseline. Integrating GPU-HADVPPM4HIP V1.0 into EPICC-Model V1.6.0 yielded three distinct versions: the initial HIP-based version (HIP-Ori), a version optimized for CPU and GPU communication frequency (HIP-Opt1), and a further-optimized version employing a thread-block coordinated indexing strategy (HIP-Opt2). Compared to the HIP-Ori version, HIP-Opt1 achieved a model-level computational efficiency improvement of 17.0×. Building upon HIP-Opt1, HIP-Opt2 delivered an additional 1.5× enhancement in computational efficiency. At the module level, including CPU and GPU data transfer overhead, the GPU implementation improves computational efficiency of the advection module by 39.3 %; when communication cost is excluded, the advection module attains a 20.5× acceleration relative to its CPU counterpart. This coupling establishes a foundational framework for adapting air quality models to GPU-like architectures and identifies critical optimization pathways. Moreover, the methodology provides essential technical support for achieving full-model GPU implementation of the EPICC-Model, addressing both current computational constraints and future demands for high-resolution air quality simulations.

explanation: 该论文研究了基于人工智能的天气预报模型与传统物理模型在洪水预测中的表现，使用了WRF模型和GNSS数据等与大气环境遥感技术相关的方法。虽然主要关注天气预报，但其涉及的数据同化、模型验证等技术与大气环境遥感领域（如空气质量监测、卫星观测）有较强的关联性。
topic_words: ['Artificial intelligence', 'weather prediction', 'WRF model', 'GNSS Zenith Total Delay']
authors: Haseeb ur Rehman;Félicia Norma Rebecca Teferle
title: Physics vs. AI in weather prediction: evaluating GraphCast, AIFS, and FuXi against an observation-corrected WRF model for flash floods
abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) weather models are now competing with traditional physics-based models for flood forecasting. We tested three of them and a physics-based model against observations from three flood events in Luxembourg. The AI models detected light rain and predicted temperatures better, but the physics-based model was more skilful at the heavy rainfall that actually causes floods. One AI model kept its skill on an event after its training period. 
 Data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) weather models are increasingly positioned as alternatives or complements to physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems, yet systematic model evaluation studies that compare both paradigms under controlled experimental conditions remain limited. Here we present a structured model evaluation framework applying standardised verification metrics to assess a regional WRF configuration against three publicly available AI models – GraphCast, AIFS Single 1.0, and FuXi – over three high-impact flood events in Luxembourg and the Greater Region (2016, 2018, and 2021), comprising around 90 simulated days per configuration and 92 119 matched forecast–observation pairs at a four-country network of 259 to 280 stations per event, each screened to be independent of the observations assimilated in that event (Fig. 1). The WRF model employs a three-dimensional variational (3D-VAR) data assimilation scheme ingesting GNSS Zenith Total Delay and conventional observations on a 6-hourly Rapid Update Cycle. All systems draw their initial and boundary information from the same ERA5 reanalysis, although the effective initial states are not identical: WRF is cycled and, in the assimilated configuration, corrected by observations, and ERA5 lateral boundary forcing of a limited-area model differs structurally from a global rollout. Categorical precipitation scores evaluated at thresholds from 1 to 20 mm (6 h)−1 and continuous temperature metrics at surface stations serve as verification targets. Data assimilation raises WRF's categorical precipitation skill at the 1 mm threshold (Critical Success Index: 0.364 to 0.389, a difference not resolved by a block bootstrap over 24 h blocks) and brings the near-surface temperature bias close to zero, although this benefit does not extend to heavier rainfall: at 10 mm (6 h)−1 the assimilated run scores below the unassimilated one. The degradation appears in all three events and is not ordered by the density of the assimilated observing network, so we report it without attributing a cause. At the 1 mm threshold AIFS achieves the highest detection rate (POD 0.835) and GraphCast the highest net categorical skill (CSI 0.424, against 0.415 for AIFS and 0.389 for the assimilated WRF), and AIFS and GraphCast reduce temperature RMSE by 19.0 % and 17.6 % relative to assimilated WRF at the subset of stations that also report temperature. This ordering reverses as the rainfall threshold increases: at 20 mm (6 h)−1 WRF attains the highest skill (CSI 0.160), ahead of AIFS (0.141) and GraphCast (0.114), while FuXi produces no exceedances at all. A weather-radar comparison over 27 6 h periods shows the same reversal in space: AIFS holds the highest mean per-period Fractions Skill Score at 1 mm (6 h)−1 at every neighbourhood width, but at 20 mm (6 h)−1 both WRF configurations are ahead of all three AI models on that estimator, and a WRF configuration leads on the pooled aggregate as well. The per-event breakdown reveals no skill degradation for GraphCast on the 2021 event, which lies outside its training period – indeed its skill is highest there – demonstrating useful skill on this later event without identifying the cause of the event-to-event differences; the same test cannot be applied to AIFS, whose fine-tuning window encompasses all three events. These results provide a replicable model evaluation methodology for benchmarking emerging data-driven NWP systems against observation-corrected regional models.

authors: K. Okun;A. J. Lucas;E. Masunaga;G. Pawlak
title: A Predictable Component of the Internal Tide on a Narrow Continental Shelf
abstract: Coastal internal tides are considered unpredictable: harmonic fits to depth‐varying baroclinic velocity explain little variance. We show the depth‐averaged coastal internal tide is predictable from astronomical forcing. On the inner shelf, coastal trapped wave (CTW) modes are approximately depth‐uniform, so depth‐averaging recovers their coherent sum at the forcing frequency, while multimodal interference degrades coherence in depth‐varying velocity. SUNTANS simulations of M2 ${M}_{2}$‐forced CTWs in the Southern California Bight produce coherent phase propagation over several hundred km, sustained by distributed generation along the coast. Applying a harmonic skill score to seven‐year ADCP records at three inner‐shelf sites yields a 35 percentage point SS90 ${\mathrm{S}\mathrm{S}}_{90}$ gap between depth‐varying and depth‐averaged projections. Tidal‐band motions are ∼28% of alongshore variance, ∼73% of it depth‐averaged and dominated by the trapped wave, not surface tides. Predictability requires a slope supporting CTW generation at the relevant frequency and an analysis variable capturing the depth‐averaged response.
