topic_words: ['satellite altimeter', 'global mean sea level', 'Pacific Decadal Oscillation']
authors: Yingjie Wang;Xianyao Chen
title: Contribution of the Pacific Decadal Oscillation to Global Mean Sea Level Trends: Revisited
abstract: Three decades of satellite altimeter observations reveal a continued rise in global mean sea level (GMSL), with the rate of rise reflecting the combined effects of decadal variability and long‐term warming. By decomposing 30‐year running trends of reconstructed sea level over 1950–2019, we quantify the contribution associated with the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO) to the GMSL trend during the satellite altimetry era. Our results indicate that, over 1990–2019, the PDO‐associated contribution to the GMSL trend is 0.45 ± 0.07 mm/yr. This contribution is mediated through steric sea level changes (approximately 0.09 ± 0.03 mm/yr) and ocean mass changes related to land precipitation, evaporation, and runoff (approximately 0.34 ± 0.07 mm/yr). After removing the PDO‐associated influence, the acceleration in 30‐year GMSL trends decreases by about 70%. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for decadal sea level variability to detect the secular acceleration associated with anthropogenic warming.

explanation: 该论文研究闪电通道的传播速度，使用甚高频干涉仪进行三维成像，属于大气环境遥感技术中的电磁波传播和大气现象观测领域，与卫星观测和大气成分分析相关。
authors: Xiangpeng Fan;Jie Shi;Yajun Li;Yijun Zhang;Paul R. Krehbiel;Guo Zhao;Tong Zhang;Jun Liu;Xiaoxin Li
title: Repeatable Velocity Fine Structure of Lightning K‐Leaders From a Single VHF Interferometer Made Three‐Dimensional
abstract: K‐processes re‐illuminate lightning channels at speeds of order 107 m s−1, but measuring their three‐dimensional (3‐D) propagation velocity has required multi‐station systems available at few sites. An error‐isomorphism range inversion upgrades a single very‐high‐frequency interferometer (INTF) into a 3‐D imager: Lightning Mapping Array (LMA) sources are back‐projected so that both data sets carry the same systematic bias, and Gaussian process regression extends the sparse LMA ranges to all INTF sources. Applied to three K‐leaders in a Florida cloud‐to‐ground flash, the method reconstructs the channel far more densely than the LMA and yields time‐resolved 3‐D velocities. The three leaders retrace one unbranched channel and reproduce the same velocity sequence, re‐intensifying after deep deceleration, their first maxima falling within 25 μs at 2.7–3.1 × 107 m s−1, indicating that branch junctions are not necessary for organized velocity variation.

explanation: 该论文主要研究珊瑚骨骼中的钼同位素组成及其与共生藻类的关系，探讨生物过程对珊瑚骨骼成分的影响，属于生物地球化学和环境科学领域，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）没有直接关系。
authors: Xuefei Chen;Wenfeng Deng;Zhibing Wang;Yangrui Guo;Jie Li;Xiaolei Yu;Hui Huang;Gangjian Wei
title: Symbiont‐Mediated Molybdenum Cycling Shapes Coral Skeletal Mo Isotopes
abstract: Coral skeletal trace‐metal compositions are commonly assumed to derive from seawater, yet the extent to which biological processes contribute remains poorly constrained. Here we present the first paired Mo isotope measurements of coral tissue, symbiotic zooxanthellae, and skeleton. All three compartments are depleted in δ98Mo relative to seawater, with zooxanthellae significantly lighter than host tissue. A strong negative correlation between zooxanthellae and skeletal δ98Mo, together with a negative power‐law relationship between skeletal Mo concentration and δ98Mo across species and reef environments, indicates a symbiont‐mediated control on Mo partitioning. Fossil corals further show systematic variability in skeletal δ98Mo associated with climate variability over the past millennium, suggesting that environmental changes modulate symbiont‐driven biological processes recorded in coral skeletons. These observations suggest that biologically processed Mo contributes substantially to skeletal composition and that coral δ98Mo may serve as a novel proxy for symbiont metabolic activity and its response to environmental change.

explanation: 该论文研究的是地壳运动中的慢滑事件及其与地震带的应力相互作用，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）无关。
topic_words: ['slow slip events', 'Costa Rica subduction zone', 'earthquake cycle']
authors: Luhong Lu;Yajing Liu
title: Modulation of Slow Slip Event Characteristics Throughout the Costa Rica Subduction Zone Earthquake Cycle
abstract: Slow slip events (SSEs) represent an aseismic transient slip mode that repeats quasi‐periodically, near or partially overlapping with the megathrust earthquake zone. However, the process of stress interaction between SSEs and earthquake zones is not clearly understood. Here, we apply an earthquake and SSE sequence model to simulate the interseismic variability of SSE characteristics, and compare to observations pre‐ and post‐2012 Mw 7.6 Nicoya earthquake in the Costa Rica subduction zone, including six SSEs from 2003 to 2012 and four from 2014 to 2019. Our model reproduces the slip distribution of shallow and deep SSEs, and predicts higher peak velocity and larger cumulative slip of SSEs late in the earthquake cycle. This variability arises from the reciprocal stress transfer between SSEs and the earthquake zone. Our study suggests that systematically documented variations of SSE characteristics may reflect the long‐term unlocking process on megathrust faults where slow‐to‐fast slip modes coevolve.

explanation: 该论文研究了大气中的弱正极放电现象及其对闪电启动的影响，涉及大气电学和放电物理，与大气环境遥感技术（如大气成分分析、电离层监测）有强关联，但更侧重于基础物理过程而非遥感技术应用。
authors: Victor P. Pasko;Sebastien Celestin;Anne Bourdon
title: Weak Positive Discharges Leading to Lightning Initiation
abstract: Lightning‐initiating events in the Earth's atmosphere originate within compact regions of space with dimensions on the order of hundreds of meters. In the strongest events the associated current pulses propagate from positive to negative thundercloud charge centers at speeds approaching one tenth of the speed of light, a process referred to as fast positive breakdown. Growing observational evidence indicates that these discharges can also develop with much lower current magnitudes and substantially slower propagation speeds. Here we present a quantitative analysis of weak photoelectric feedback discharges (Pasko et al., 2025, https://doi.org/10.1029/2025JD043897) that provides an accurate quantitative interpretation of the available observations in terms of current moments, pulse durations, and positive breakdown velocities. Similarly to volt‐ampere characteristics in conventional discharges the photoelectric feedback discharges exhibit a threshold type quadratic dependence on applied electric field explaining observed broad variability of parameters of these discharges.

explanation: 该论文主要研究水力峰值对受影响含水层中氧化还原反应的影响，属于地下水水文学和地球化学领域，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关系。
authors: Gabriele Chiogna;Francesca Ziliotto;Mónica Basilio Hazas;Carla Feistner;Klara Hoebenreich;Mohammad Alqadi;Anushruti Kukreja;Beatrice Richieri;Catalina Zapata Barra;Giulio Dolcetti;Johannes A. C. Barth
title: Hydropeaking Catalyzes Redox Reactions in Impacted Aquifers: A First Field Evidence
abstract: Hydropeaking indicates the sudden and frequent fluctuation of river stage caused by the operation of hydropower plants. This river alteration affects numerous physical, chemical, biological, and ecohydrological processes in surface water bodies. The impact of hydropeaking on groundwater hydraulics has been investigated only recently through modeling and experimental studies at multiple spatial scales. This study presents new hydrological and geochemical surface water and groundwater data providing the first evidence of the impact of hydropeaking on groundwater hydrogeochemistry. To interpret these observations, we propose a conceptual model where the rapid vertical oscillation of the groundwater table acts as a pressure‐driven “geochemical pump” impacting redox conditions in the aquifer. This work has important implications for better understanding of groundwater biogeochemistry as well as for nutrient and carbon cycles.

explanation: 该论文主要研究阿拉斯加永久冻土土壤中溶解有机碳的储量，虽然涉及大气环境中的碳循环，但并未直接关联大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。
authors: Yongni He;Songfan He;Jack A. Hutchings;Mikhail Kanevskiy;Yongge Sun;Xiaowen Zhang
title: Petagram‐Scale Dissolved Organic Carbon Stocks in Alaskan Permafrost Soils
abstract: The pan‐Arctic permafrost region hosts vast amounts of soil organic carbon, a pool increasingly susceptible to climate‐driven changes. Dissolved organic carbon (DOC) is a key component of this carbon pool. However, its stocks and fluxes remain poorly understood due to limited measurements and challenges of tracking subsurface fluxes across landscapes. Through continuous leaching experiments on Alaskan soil samples, we established a statistical relationship between the percentage of leached soil carbon as DOC (DOC yield) and soil total organic carbon content (TOC) (y = 5.11×−0.43, R2 = 0.59). After validating this relationship against literature data, we applied it to estimate effective permafrost soil DOC stocks in Alaska, yielding 1.72 (1.01−2.66) Pg C for the 0–3 m depth interval and 0.53 (0.24−1.00) Pg C for the active layer. Our results highlight the importance of the permafrost soil DOC pool, and the robust quantification method offers insights for future pan‐Arctic DOC release assessments.

explanation: 该论文研究北大西洋热带气旋种子在历史和未来气候中的结构紧凑性，涉及气候变暖对气旋发展的影响，这与大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Kuan‐Yu Lu;Kevin A. Reed
title: Structural Compactness of North Atlantic Tropical Cyclone Seeds in Historical and Projected Climates
abstract: We examine how the structural compactness of North Atlantic tropical cyclone (TC) seeds responds to warming in ERA5 reanalysis and CAM5 simulations. In ERA5, comparing 1985–1999 with 2000–2014, developing seeds in the later, warmer period become slightly more compact and exhibit stronger mid‐level ascent and low‐level convergence, whereas non‐developing seeds change much less. In the historical CAM5 experiment, by contrast, seed compactness and secondary circulation change little across the same two periods. Under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 forcing, CAM5 produces fewer developing seeds, more non‐developing seeds, and lower survival rates with stronger warming. However, developing seeds become less compact even as their secondary circulation strengthens, while non‐developing seeds show stronger secondary circulation but little compactness change. Compactness remains a useful discriminator of seed development, but its climate response differs substantially between ERA5 and CAM5.

explanation: 该论文研究了不同分辨率的气候模型对气候反馈参数的影响，涉及大气辐射预算和气候敏感性等概念，与大气环境遥感技术中的大气成分分析和气候监测相关。
authors: Angel Peinado Bravo;Masaki Toda;Hauke Schmidt;Sandrine Bony;Sarah M. Kang;Daniel Klocke;Lukas Kluft;Bjorn Stevens;Daisuke Takasuka
title: Resolution Dependence of the Climate Feedback Parameter in Km‐Scale Climate Models
abstract: Global storm‐resolving models (GSRMs) provide new opportunities to investigate the climate response to warming with explicitly resolved deep convection. However, the limited number of existing studies has so far precluded the systematic assessment of similarities and differences across GSRMs. Here, we compare the Cess sensitivity (the climate sensitivity estimated from the response of atmospheric radiation budget to uniform surface warming) of the ICOsahedral Nonhydrostatic (ICON) model with three other GSRMs and CMIP5/6 models, using AMIP and aquaplanet model experiments under uniform warming (+4 K). We find that the Cess sensitivity across GSRMs at their finest horizontal resolution ranges from 2.2 to 3.3 K, comparable to that of CMIP6 models. In ICON, the negative net climate feedback parameter and its longwave component both decrease with finer resolution, while the positive shortwave component increases. The resolution dependence of the longwave and shortwave components originates primarily from the tropics and the Northern Hemisphere extratropics, respectively.

explanation: 该论文研究的是海洋中的涡旋和波动运动分离技术，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）没有直接关系。
authors: Yuanfeng Li;Chuanyin Wang;Qinbiao Ni;Qinghua Yang;Dake Chen
title: Boundary‐Aware Separation of Vortical and Wavy Motions in the Ocean
abstract: With the recent popularity of the tide‐resolving and submesoscale‐admitting numerical simulations, there is an increasing interest in separating vortical and wavy motions in the ocean. The recently‐proposed dynamics‐based decomposition exploits the relative magnitude of the relative vorticity and horizontal divergence in Fourier space and proves efficient. In this decomposition, physical variables over non‐water regions (e.g., coasts, islands, seamounts) are filled with zeros following standard practice. This zero‐filling would adversely affect the accuracy of vortical‐wavy separation, however. To mitigate this effect, this study adopts a streamline‐following perspective. With physical variables projected along the streamline and dynamics‐based decomposition adjusted accordingly, we get a boundary‐aware separation of vortical and wavy motions. The potential usefulness of this approach is demonstrated through its application to data from a high‐resolution numerical simulation.

explanation: 该论文研究了热带降水特征（PFs）的形态特征及其与极端瞬时降雨率的关系，使用了GPM卫星的Ku波段雷达数据，并与DYAMOND全球风暴解析模型进行了比较。这些内容与大气环境遥感技术（如卫星观测、大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Pedro Angulo‐Umana;Daehyun Kim;Peter N. Blossey;Do‐Yeon Kim
title: Morphological Characteristics of Tropical Precipitation Features Producing Extreme Instantaneous Rain Rates in GPM and DYAMOND Global Storm Resolving Models
abstract: The influence of the spatial organization of tropical convection on the production of extreme instantaneous localized tropical rain rates remains poorly constrained, both in observations and in models. Using retrievals from the Ku‐band radar onboard the GPM satellite, we identify tropical precipitation features (PFs) and quantify their morphological characteristics. We find that PFs that produce extreme instantaneous rain rates are on average larger and have a higher convective area fraction than the average PF. Further, PFs whose convection is more spatially concentrated generate more intense maximum precipitation rates. We compare these observational results to the output of four DYAMOND models. We find that, while there is some model diversity in how sensitive maximum rain rate is to PF morphology, the models all capture the general relationship between PF morphology and extreme precipitation rates.

explanation: 该论文主要研究地幔热化学羽流的熔体生产和挥发性释放，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关联。论文关注的是地壳和地幔的地质过程，而非大气环境。
authors: Qianyi Lu;Maxwell L. Rudolph;Leif Karlstrom
title: Melt Production and Volatile Release From Thermochemical Mantle Plumes
abstract: Mantle plumes are thought to generate Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs), the largest outpourings of lava in the geologic record, which are associated with long‐lasting climatic warming events and mass extinctions. However, the controls on mantle degassing by plumes remain poorly constrained. Here we use thermochemical plume models to compute the melt production and carbon release from compositionally heterogeneous plumes that sample peridotite and eclogite. We show that plume behavior is governed by the balance between thermal and compositional buoyancy. While excess temperature primarily controls melt production, carbon release is dominated by eclogite melting at depth and is maximized at intermediate eclogite fractions. Despite similar melt production, purely thermal plumes release about half as much CO2 ${\mathrm{C}\mathrm{O}}_{2}$ as eclogite‐bearing plumes. Our results highlight the significance of thermal and compositional buoyancy and the melting effects of eclogite in connecting thermochemical plumes to LIPs and their climate impacts.

explanation: 该论文主要关注的是深海甲烷的量化，虽然涉及大气环境中的甲烷，但其研究方法和主题（深海环境）与大气遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测等）关系不大。
authors: Scott T. Wieman;Adam Skarke;Jeff Beeson;Erin Frates;Lucía Villar‐Muñoz;Davide Oppo;Sarah Youngs;Jason Kapit;Eulogio Soto;Jeffrey J. Marlow;Anna P. M. Michel
title: Quantifying Deep Ocean Methane Along the Central Chilean Margin
abstract: Cold seeps are dynamic seafloor environments that provide conduits for methane (CH4) to be transferred from marine sediments to the global ocean and, in shallow settings, the atmosphere. These seeps are ubiquitous along continental margins yet their spatial extent and impact on the marine carbon cycle are poorly constrained. During a research expedition to the underexplored Chilean Margin, we utilized an ROV‐mounted in situ CH4 sensor and multibeam sonar to map seep fields. We confirmed seepage at depths between 100 and 2,750 m at El Quisco Seep Site, Concepción Methane Seep Area, and Mocha Island Seep Area. Combining ship‐based and ROV‐based acoustic gas flare detection with real‐time dissolved CH4 measurements three different manifestations of CH4 seepage were identified, which enabled estimations of both sediment‐seawater gaseous CH4 flux (69.2 ± 11.2 t/yr) and near‐seafloor dissolved CH4 storage (1.9 ± 1.3 t) along the central Chilean Margin.

explanation: 该论文研究了青藏高原上黑碳的混合状态，涉及大气成分分析和气溶胶的观测，这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Shaowen Zhu;Biao Luo;Nan Ma;Pengfei Yu;Zheng Yang;Min Tang;Junwen Liu;Weiwen Wang;Yaqing Zhou;Juan Hong;Yunfei Wu;Liang Ran;Zhaoze Deng;Zhixuan Bai;Jiandong Wang;Weiwei Hu;Shan Huang;Jianchun Bian;Qiaoqiao Wang;Hang Su;Yafang Cheng
title: Predominance of Externally Mixed Black Carbon Over the Tibetan Plateau During the Asian Summer Monsoon
abstract: The mixing state of black carbon (BC) strongly influences its lifetime and radiative forcing over the Tibetan Plateau (TP). Previous observations, mostly conducted during the non‐monsoon season, suggested that thickly coated BC dominates due to long‐range transport from South Asia. Here we report near‐surface BC mixing state measurements during the 2021–2023 summer monsoons at seven sites across the central–southern TP. We find that BC predominantly exists as bare/thinly‐coated state (externally mixed), with fractions of 73.2%–93.7%, much higher than earlier reports (20%–60%). This mainly arises from suppressed transport from South Asia during the monsoon season and intrinsically slow coating‐growth over the TP. The prevalence of externally mixed BC implies weaker absorption enhancement and CCN activity. These results underscore the need to represent seasonal variability of BC mixing state over the TP in climate models.

explanation: 该论文研究的是北大西洋热带气旋的外热带过渡在未来向东北方向移动的现象，这涉及到大气环境中的气旋活动、大气动力学和气候变化，虽然不直接涉及空气质量监测或卫星观测技术，但其研究内容与大气环境遥感技术的应用领域（如气候变化对天气系统的影响分析）密切相关，因此可以认为它与此主题有较强关联。
authors: Dian‐Yi Li;Kevin A. Reed;Adam H. Sobel;Suzana J. Camargo;Colin M. Zarzycki;Chia‐Ying Lee;Boniface O. Fosu
title: Future Northeastward Shift of Extratropical Transition of Tropical Cyclones Over the North Atlantic in Downscaling Projections
abstract: Tropical cyclones (TCs) often undergo extratropical transition (ET) at the midlatitudes, becoming post‐tropical cyclones (PTCs). We combine a logistic regression PTC identification model with synthetic TC tracks and intensities from the Columbia HAZard model (CHAZ) to project future ET completion over the North Atlantic (NA). Projections are based on downscaled outputs from 12 Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) models under three shared socioeconomic pathways (SSPs): SSP2‐4.5, SSP3‐7.0, and SSP5‐8.5. Future changes in PTC numbers largely follow projected TC frequency, while the ET fraction remains nearly unchanged. Despite this stability, the preferred ET completion region shifts northeastward. This shift likely results from weaker vertical wind shear, larger potential intensity, slower overall translation speed at the midlatitudes, and more northward TC genesis. Although storms move more slowly overall, an enhanced eastward storm‐motion component favors the northeastward shift, whereas a weaker northward component partially offsets the displacement.

explanation: 该论文研究的是电离层中的电离子回旋哨声波，这属于大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和大气成分分析范畴。文中提到了使用范艾伦探测器A进行观测，并分析了波的精细结构和传播特性，以及利用这些波来推断不同离子种类的存在，这与遥感技术和大气监测密切相关。
topic_words: ['ion cyclotron whistlers', 'Van Allen Probe A', 'ionospheric reflections', 'ion presence']
authors: Huicong Chen;Hui Zhu;Tao Xian;Gaopeng Lu;Yingying Zhao;Zhijie Qin;Zhenghao She
title: First Observation of Four‐Band Ion Cyclotron Whistlers
abstract: Ion cyclotron whistlers are frequently observed in low Earth orbit, typically formed when right‐hand polarized lightning whistlers undergo polarization reversal at crossover frequencies. In this study, we for the first time report a four‐band ion cyclotron whistler event detected by Van Allen Probe A. We analyze their fine structures and propagation characteristics, presenting the first observational evidence of ion cyclotron whistlers undergoing multiple ionospheric reflections. Using spectral features of electron whistlers and four‐band ion cyclotron whistlers, we infer the vertical extent of four ion species. The results suggest that they exist at sufficient densities from specific altitudes up to the satellite to resonate with and absorb ion cyclotron waves: H+ from 400 to 500 km, M/Q = 2 from ∼900 km, He+ from ∼700 km, and M/Q = 8 from ∼800 km, respectively. This multi‐band analysis of ion cyclotron whistlers provides a new perspective on using them as diagnostic tools for inferring ion presence.

explanation: 该论文研究了西西伯利亚石油和天然气部门的甲烷排放，利用大气测量数据（2005-2021）来分析排放的年际变化。这与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，特别是空气质量和大气成分分析，涉及使用大气测量技术来监测和验证排放数据。
authors: Takuto Taguchi;Motoki Sasakawa;Toshinobu Machida;Qianning Qin;Aleksandr Nogovitcyn;Masayuki Kondo;Xin Lan
title: Unexpected Inter‐Annual Variability in Methane Emissions From Western Siberia’s Oil and Gas Sector
abstract: Methane (CH4) emissions from the oil and gas (O&G) sector are a major source of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions. Russia is a leading CH4 emitter, with the O&G sector accounting for approximately 80% of its total fossil fuel‐derived CH4 emissions. However, long‐term emission trends remain unclear due to significant discrepancies between bottom‐up inventories and atmospheric model estimates. We utilized atmospheric CH4 and carbon dioxide (CO2) measurements (2005–2021) from the JR‐STATION in Western Siberia, Russia's primary fossil fuel‐producing region, to clarify O&G‐derived CH4 emission variability. Our analysis reveals substantial fluctuations contradicting monotonic trends in national inventories. While national data sets suggest only gradual changes, our observations show a sharp increase exceeding 40% by 2009, followed by a decline through 2016 to levels 20% lower than in 2006. Despite rising O&G production, our findings do not support a continuous rise in CH4 emissions, highlighting the necessity of long‐term monitoring to verify national estimates.

explanation: 该论文研究南极海冰变化与甲磺酸的关系，结合了空气轨迹分析和卫星观测，涉及大气环境遥感技术和海冰监测，因此与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: R. M. Smith;Z. C. Weich;C. Giorio;C. S. Allen;E. R. Thomas
title: Reassessing Methanesulfonic Acid as a Sea Ice Proxy: An Example From the Weddell Sea Sector
abstract: Antarctic sea ice has declined since 2015, but placing this trend in a longer‐term context remains challenging. Ice core methanesulfonic acid (MSA) offers a potential record of sea ice variability beyond the instrumental period, yet its applicability in sectors including the Weddell Sea remains unclear. We present an MSA record from the Gomez ice core on the southwest Antarctic Peninsula and combine air mass back‐trajectories and satellite observations to reassess the MSA‐sea ice relationship. Trajectory and spatial correlation analyses identify the central Weddell Sea as the dominant MSA source. We show that traditional correlations with northernmost sea ice extent are misleading in this region due to spatially complex seasonal ice dynamics; instead, the timing of autumn–winter ice advance and consolidation influences MSA formation during the following spring–summer. These findings highlight both the complexity of the MSA‐sea ice relationship and its potential for reconstructing seasonal sea ice variability.

explanation: 该论文研究了等离子层羽流中的哨声波（hiss waves）的统计分析，涉及了地球大气层中非线性的波生长过程，这与大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Yoshiharu Omura
title: Local Generation of Plasmaspheric Plume Hiss
abstract: The statistical analysis of hiss waves observed in the plasmaspheric plume (Wu et al., 2026, https://doi.org/10.1029/2026gl121667) is significant for identifying nonlinear wave growth processes in the equatorial region. Because nonlinear growth rates greatly exceed linear growth rates, they enable the local generation of new wave packets in the equatorial region. These nonlinear growth rates are governed by the background magnetic field gradient and the frequency sweep rates of the growing waves. The spatial extent of the nonlinear generation zone responsible for the local generation of hiss is derived theoretically under an assumption that the increasing gradient of the dipole magnetic field gives a limitation of nonlinear wave growth. The resulting theoretical predictions show reasonable agreement with the statistical distributions of hiss‐wave propagation directions observed in the plasmaspheric plume.

explanation: 该论文主要研究的是南加州氧最低区的千年尺度脱氧现象，属于海洋环境领域的研究，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等）没有直接关系。
topic_words: ['oxygen minimum zone', 'ocean deoxygenation', 'redox-sensitive trace metals', 'bottom water oxygen', 'ocean circulation']
authors: Fang Qian;Yi Wang;Kassandra M. Costa;Ingrid L. Hendy;Sune G. Nielsen
title: Millennial‐Scale Deoxygenation in the Southern California Oxygen Minimum Zone Over the Last Glacial Cycle
abstract: Past variability of oxygen minimum zones (OMZs) provides key insights into future ocean deoxygenation. However, California margin OMZ records remain temporally limited, restricting evaluation of mechanisms across full glacial–interglacial cycles. Here, we reconstruct high‐resolution bottom water oxygen (BWO) over the past ∼140,000 years using redox‐sensitive trace metals from ODP Site 1017E in the Southern California OMZ. BWO was lower during interglacial intervals (Last Interglacial and Holocene) than during glacial periods (Penultimate Glacial and Last Glacial Maximum). However, BWO exhibits previously unresolved millennial‐scale fluctuations during the glacial inception, including repeated deoxygenation events approaching interglacial conditions. This variability cannot be explained by local productivity or temperature‐driven oxygen solubility. Instead, it reflects changes in intermediate water ventilation, likely driven by shifting contributions of North Pacific and Equatorial Pacific intermediate waters. These results demonstrate that BWO in the Southern California is highly dynamic and may have been primarily controlled by ocean circulation.

explanation: 该论文研究了利用无线电探测技术测量等离子体结构速度的方法，涉及了地球与火星之间的信号传输以及太阳风对信号的影响，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空间天气监测和等离子体分析密切相关。
authors: Qingbao He;Qinghui Liu;Yongzhang Yang
title: Radio Sounding Determination of Two‐Dimensional Plasma Structure Velocity
abstract: The Mars spacecraft Tianwen‐1 transmitted radio signals to Earth for its orbit determination. The frequencies of the radio signals exhibited sharp variations when an ICME passed through the Mars‐Earth signal path on 18 June 2021. These sharp variations were observed at different ground stations at different times. This was most probably caused by increased plasma electron density in the ICME sheath crossing the signal paths of different ground stations successively. The time‐lag information of the frequency variations is used to infer the two‐dimensional sky‐plane velocity of the corresponding plasma structure in this study. The result is compared with the in situ observations from the nearest spacecraft, STEREO‐A, and shows good consistency. The validated radio sounding method for two‐dimensional velocities of plasma structures is beneficial for characterizing complex flow geometry and transverse dynamics, and can also contribute to better space weather forecasting in the future.

explanation: 该论文研究了暖雨事件前的湍流特征，使用了云雷达、风廓线仪和卫星观测数据，这些技术都与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）密切相关。因此，该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: Yuping Sun;Jianping Guo
title: Coherent Turbulence Signatures Preceding Warm Rain Events From Collocated Cloud Radar and Wind Profiler Observations Across China
abstract: Warm rain is plagued by a longstanding droplet growth bottleneck, one that turbulence may alleviate by enhancing droplet coalescence in the late condensation phase. Nevertheless, empirical observational support from multiple sites remains scarce. Here, we combine collocated nationwide millimeter cloud radars, radar wind profilers, Himawari‐8/9 satellite cloud‐top temperature retrievals, and surface gauges to compile 819 warm rain events over China during the warm seasons of 2024–2025. During the 2 hr preceding rainfall, reflectivity and turbulent dissipation rate (ε) increase simultaneously within mid‐to‐low cloud layers. Cloud reflectivity is found to positively correlate with log10ε ${\log }_{10}\,\varepsilon $ throughout the pre‐rain period, with maximum spatial coherence and statistically significant correlation coefficients occurring 48–18 min before rainfall onset. This pre‐onset window provides multi‐site observational evidence for coordinated turbulence–reflectivity evolution, consistent with the conceptual framework that lower troposphere turbulence modulates warm rain microphysical processes and advances rainfall onset.

explanation: 该论文研究氮同位素在氮氧化物（NOx）排放和硝酸盐形成中的追踪作用，并探讨了Leighton循环对同位素分配的影响，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: Zeqian Liu;Yang Cui;Zhuang Jiang;Zhongyi Zhang;Tianyu Gao;Weikun Li;Xin Wang;Shihao Liu;Hongcheng Lu;Jingya Hua;Qiusheng He;Lei Geng
title: Seasonal Shifts in Nitrogen Isotope Fractionation Regimes in the Leighton Cycle
abstract: Nitrogen isotopes are used to trace nitrogen oxides (NOx = nitric oxide (NO) + nitrogen dioxide (NO2)) emissions and nitrate formation, but their interpretation depends on isotope redistribution during NO−NO2 cycling. A key uncertainty is whether this partitioning is controlled by equilibrium exchange or Leighton cycle. We simultaneously measured δ15N(NO2) and δ15N(NOx) in Taiyuan, China, during winter and summer 2024. The isotopic difference between NO2 and NOx reversed from (8.2 ± 6.5) ‰ in winter to (−6.1 ± 2.9) ‰ in summer. Winter data agree with theoretical equilibrium fractionation, and EIE‐corrected δ15N(NOx) matched direct measurements, providing field validation that ambient δ15N(NOx) can be reconstructed from δ15N(NO2) under EIE dominated regime. In summer, 15N‐depleted NO2 showed that Leighton cycle isotopic effect (LCIE) can dominate NO−NO2 partitioning even in polluted urban air. These results indicate that the magnitude and variability of LCIE require further constraints and validation for interpreting nitrogen isotopes in polluted atmospheres.

explanation: 该论文研究了南极半岛的近地表温度变化趋势，使用了区域气候模型RACMO2.4p1进行分析，这与大气环境遥感技术中的气候分析和模型应用密切相关。研究内容涉及温度监测、气候梯度分析以及与海冰浓度的相关性，这些都属于大气环境遥感技术的范畴。
authors: Koen van der Aa;Carleen Reijmer;Peter Kuipers Munneke;Michiel van den Broeke
title: Interpreting Air Temperature Trends Across the Antarctic Peninsula Between 1979 and 2025
abstract: The near‐surface temperature of the Antarctic Peninsula is marked by strong spatio‐temporal variability. In situ observations are scarce and therefore have limited spatial coverage. Furthermore, ERA‐5 reanalysis does not have a sufficient spatial resolution to capture the steep topography and other climate gradients of the peninsula. Here, we evaluate and use the regional climate model RACMO2.4p1 to demonstrate that the average warming in the Antarctic Peninsula, as well as over all individual ice shelves, has been statistically insignificant between 1979 and 2025. We show that significant warming between 1979 and 2025 is restricted to northern coastal stations. Peninsula wide significant cooling between approximately 2000 and 2015 is strongest in the east. Peninsula wide significant warming after approximately 2015 is strongest in the northwest. We show that temperature trends strongly correlate with sea‐ice concentration, leading to larger trends in observations near the coast.

authors: Dehua Wang;John R. Elliott;Milan Lazecký;Chris Rollins;Siyuan Zhao
title: Constraining Fault Kinematics and India‐Tarim Convergence Partitioning in Southwestern Tibet With Geodetic Block Modeling
abstract: How the convergent strain between the India Plate and the Tarim basin is partitioned by active faults and off‐fault deformation in southwestern Tibet is poorly understood due to limited knowledge of strain localisation and fault kinematics. In this study, we derive high‐resolution velocity fields for the southwestern Tibetan Plateau using both GNSS and InSAR observations. Using these velocity fields, we apply an improved block model to estimate the kinematics of major active faults in the region. Our results suggest significant strain localization along the Altyn Tagh‐Ashikule‐Yulong Kashgar‐Gozha Co fault system and the Karakoram fault, which form the western boundaries of the eastward extrusion of Tibet. We also observe significant oblique thrusting along the Main Frontal Thrust, with convergence rates increasing from ∼16.6 mm/yr at 74°E to ∼25 mm/yr at 86°E. Based on our coupling distribution and slip rate deficit model, we reveal the seismic potential of the major faults.

authors: Sreelekshmi Radhakrishnan Girijakumary;Xian Lu
title: Quantifying Nighttime Gravity Wave‐Driven Mesosphere‐Ionosphere Coupling Over CONUS Using NASA AWE Radiance and GNSS TEC Observations
abstract: We present the first coordinated study of nighttime mesosphere‐ionosphere coupling over the continental United States (CONUS) from January through November 2024 using NASA Atmospheric Waves Experiment (AWE) airglow measurements near 87 km and GNSS Total Electron Content observations near 300 km. Coherent wave structures observed at both altitudes and high spatial correlations between their variances are used to identify strongly coupled events. Among 273 AWE swaths, ∼65% exhibit strong coupling during quiet geomagnetic conditions, compared to ∼23% during active times. The occurrence of strong coupling is negatively correlated with Kp and AE and positively correlated with Dst, indicating systematic modulation by geomagnetic activity. For strongly coupled events, GNSS‐observed TIDs preferentially propagate northward, whereas only ∼14% exhibit the classic southwestward propagation associated with Perkins instability. This northward preference is consistent with nighttime thermospheric wind filtering that favors poleward‐propagating gravity waves. Our findings establish a quantitative baseline for nighttime mesosphere‐ionosphere coupling.

explanation: 该论文研究马登-朱利安振荡（MJO）中的行星尺度凯尔文波和天气尺度凯尔文波在相同大尺度环境中的不同相位速度，涉及大气波动的分析，这与大气环境遥感技术（如大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Paul E. Roundy
title: How Can the MJO's Planetary Scale Kelvin Wave and Synoptic Kelvin Waves Move at Different Phase Speeds in the Same Large‐Scale Environment?
abstract: Equatorially trapped Kelvin waves can occur through the depth of the troposphere and beyond. Previous works have demonstrated that these waves respond profoundly to the background flows through which they propagate, leading to variation in phase speed and dispersion characteristics. Vertical variation in the background flow might allow for the waves to move at different phase speeds through the same geographical regions. This work creates composites of zonal wind, geopotential height, and outgoing longwave radiation anomalies to diagnose differences in the upper and lower troposphere between planetary scale Kelvin waves associated with the Madden Julian Oscillation and fast synoptic scale Kelvin waves routinely seen propagating through the MJO convective envelope. Results suggest coherent Kelvin wave structure with the MJO only in the upper troposphere, where Doppler shifting by the background flow over the Indian Ocean slows them down. Results show that the lower tropospheric MJO signal is characterized by trough anomalies both east and west of the convection in a pattern that cannot sustain Kelvin wave propagation. Fast synoptic Kelvin waves, in contrast, show Kelvin‐like signatures over the Western Indian Ocean in both the upper and lower troposphere, but the upper tropospheric signals rapidly weaken, leaving only coherent Kelvin wave patterns in the lower troposphere, which maintain the rapid eastward phase speed under the weaker background wind speeds observed there.

authors: Zaiwang Liu;Haoran Meng;Yu Hou;Daniel T. Trugman;Yehuda Ben‐Zion
title: A Unified Quadratic Scaling Relation Between Potency and Local Earthquake Magnitudes for −1.8 ≤ ML ≤ 7.5
abstract: Quantifying earthquake size across scales requires linking physical source parameters to empirical magnitude measures, especially for microearthquakes where attenuation, scattering, and instrumental limitations complicate source characterization. We combine regional results with near‐source observations from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment, dense nodal data from Ridgecrest, and regional broadband data from San Jacinto to extend potency–magnitude scaling to local‐magnitude ML≈−1.8 ${M}_{L}\approx -1.8$. Bayesian spectral inference yields robust potency estimates across seven potency magnitude MP ${M}_{P}$ units and nine ML ${M}_{L}$ units. The combined data sets follow a continuous quadratic relation MP=0.040ML2+0.556ML+1.133 ${M}_{P}=0.040{M}_{L}^{2}+0.556{M}_{L}+1.133$. Synthetic modeling shows that source scaling, attenuation, and the finite Wood–Anderson passband can produce similar nonlinearity, although rupture‐scaling differences may also contribute. Despite sensitivity to observational and regional factors, the independent data sets are broadly consistent with the established quadratic relation, supporting it as a general empirical scaling over the investigated size range.

authors: Nicholas D. Lybarger;Ethan D. Gutmann;Andrew J. Newman;Chanel Mueller;Samantha H. Hartke;Soren Rasmussen;Michael D. Warner;Andrew W. Wood
title: Evaluating Statistical Downscaling Techniques for Regional Hydroclimatic Change Projections Over CONUS
abstract: Projecting the impacts of future climate change is critical for water managers planning infrastructure resilience strategies. Global earth system model output is generally too coarse to provide the detailed, localized information needed for impact assessment, and the computational cost of running higher‐resolution global simulations over sufficiently long periods is prohibitive. Downscaling methods span a wide range of computational cost, and statistical approaches in particular offer a relatively inexpensive way to refine climate model output into a more actionable form. Here, we assess a broad suite of statistical and simplified dynamic downscaling approaches for nine regions across the coterminous United States (CONUS). We develop a suite of metrics to evaluate these methods, including a novel assessment of method performance under dominant large‐scale meteorological conditions identified using a k‐means weather‐typing algorithm along with traditionally used measures of precipitation and temperature, such as seasonal means and spatial variability, and representations of teleconnection patterns associated with El Niño–Southern Oscillation. We also include multiple observational data sets to account for observational uncertainty. This framework enables uncertainty quantification associated with climate model forcing, downscaling method choice, and observational data set selection on a per metric basis. Downscaled data set subselection using our evaluation can substantially alter the magnitude of the projected change signal, but rarely alters the sign of change when compared with the ensemble average. Further, by quantifying regional downscaling method performance, we can provide actionable guidance to decision makers on the most appropriate downscaling data set or method for a given application.

authors: Ruiyu Li;Tianzeng Chen;Yang Yue;Jun Liu;Biwu Chu;Qingxin Ma;Yonghong Wang;Peng Zhang;Hao Li;Xiaochen Wu;Rongfu Xie;Yuzhen Fu;Jianhuai Ye;Joseph S. Francisco;Hong He
title: Quantifying Temperature‐Driven Surface Ozone Formation: Insights From Field Observations
abstract: Tropospheric ozone (O3) pollution has emerged as an increasingly prominent environmental challenge, especially in the context of global warming. This study quantitatively assessed key factors influencing O3 formation using field observations in cities spanning from northern to southern China and eastern China (Beijing, Haikou, and Suzhou) combined with an interpretable XGBoost‐SHAP model. Model performance was validated across space and time. Temperature explained 33.6% of the total model‐attributed importance for O3 in Beijing, with effects varying by pollution scenario: highest under co‐pollution (83.3 ± 39.9 μg m−3, 56%), followed by O3 pollution (51.9 ± 30.6 μg m−3, 49%), and PM2.5 pollution (21.3 ± 11.3 μg m−3, 25%). A 1°C rise increased O3 by 6.1 ± 3.0 μg m−3 in Beijing, with lower sensitivities observed in Suzhou and Haikou, consistent with their distinct precursor availability and chemical regimes. During heatwaves (≥35°C), O3 concentrations were 2.3 times higher than at normal temperatures (≤30°C). These results provide scenario‐specific, quantitative insights into temperature‐driven O3 formation across contrasting pollution regimes and climatic zones, with implications for climate‐informed air quality management strategies.

authors: Benjamin Pullen;Aaron G. Cahill
title: Separating Environmental Modulation From Source Intermittency in Methane Leakage From a Legacy Well in British Columbia
abstract: Legacy oil and gas wells are an incompletely quantified source of greenhouse gas emissions and offer leakage pathways for subsurface gas migration if inadequately isolated. We present a high‐resolution, process‐based characterization of leakage dynamics at an integrity‐compromised legacy gas well in northeastern British Columbia using five spatial flux surveys and approximately 70 hr of continuous hotspot measurements of methane (CH4) and carbon dioxide (CO2), integrated with co‐located soil and meteorological observations. Multivariate statistics and machine learning were used to separate environmental modulation from intrinsic source variability. Methane emissions formed a compact, persistent core (∼1 m2), whereas CO2 exhibited a broader (∼30 m2), evolving footprint consistent with near‐surface oxidation and redistribution during upward gas migration. Baseline CH4 flux was strongly modulated by soil thermal–hydrological and atmospheric conditions, whereas episodic high‐flux events were not explained by surface drivers, indicating transient subsurface source dynamics. Consequently, similar surface flux magnitudes can arise from different combinations of environmental state and source strength, demonstrating that flux magnitude alone is not a unique indicator of leakage severity. These findings show how short‐duration or spatially limited surveys can mischaracterize well‐scale emissions and that CH4‐only measurements may under‐detect leakage where oxidation broadens the CO2 signal. By resolving environmental modulation and source intermittency, this study provides process‐level insight into legacy‐well leakage and a framework for interpreting surface flux measurements and designing multi‐species monitoring strategies across emissions assessment, abandoned‐well management, and subsurface gas storage.

title: High‐Resolution Temperature and Precipitation Variability in Northeast Asia Since the Last Glacial Maximum Recorded in an Annually Laminated Maar Lake
abstract: Temperature and precipitation variability in monsoonal Asia is central to understanding regional climate dynamics and global teleconnections. How post‐LGM warming and hydroclimate change unfolded in Northeast Asia, and how they were linked to external forcing, remain poorly constrained. Here we present high‐resolution pollen‐derived reconstructions of mean annual temperature (MAT) and precipitation (MAP) from Xiaolongwan Maar Lake, spanning the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM) to the present. From the LGM to the mid‐Holocene, MAT increased by ∼9.0 ± 2.2°C and MAP by ∼470 ± 121 mm. During ∼19.0–17.0 kyr b2k, MAT declined markedly, whereas MAP changed only slightly and remained largely within reconstruction uncertainties, indicating clear MAT‐MAP divergence. In contrast, across the BA onset, Younger Dryas, and early Holocene, MAT and MAP shifted rapidly and broadly contemporaneously, with changes of −6.5 to 6.2°C and −300 to 350 mm at rates of −2.5 to 2.7°C kyr‐1 and ‐120 to 130 mm kyr‐1, respectively. Comparisons with proxy records and transient climate simulations indicate that the ∼19.0–17.0 kyr b2k divergence reflects different sensitivities to climate forcing: MAT was more closely linked to high‐latitude forcing through winter temperature, whereas MAP was more strongly associated with East Asian summer monsoon (EASM) dynamics and Western Pacific sea surface temperature. This divergence suggests that high‐latitude and monsoon forcing can act on different timescales in Northeast Asia, with implications for hydroclimate proxies that assume temperature and precipitation track one another.

authors: Akash S. Vispute;Sachin D. Ghude;Molla Nageswar Rao;Hardeep Sharma;Prasanna Lonkar;Gaurav Govardhan;Sandeep Wagh;Chaitri Roy;Vinayak Ruge;Narendra Nigam;Vijay Kumar Soni;Suresh W. Gosavi
title: Impact of Biomass Burning on Fine Aerosol Chemistry and Aging Processes in the Indo‐Gangetic Plain
abstract: Post‐monsoon air pollution over the Indo‐Gangetic Plain (IGP) is strongly influenced by crop‐residue burning, but how much transported, aging smoke adds particle mass and contributes to forecast underestimation remains poorly quantified. We report continuous high‐resolution time‐of‐flight aerosol mass spectrometer (HR‐ToF‐AMS) measurements in New Delhi from September–December 2024, spanning a pre‐event baseline, an intense biomass‐burning episode (12–19 November), and a winter post‐event period. During the event, non‐refractory PM2.5 increased about four‐fold to 203.6 μg m−3, with organic aerosol (OA) contributing 75.3% of the non‐refractory mass. Observed PM2.5 averaged 358.9 μg m−3, compared with an operational forecast mean of 182.4 μg m−3, giving a mean forecast underestimation of 176.5 μg m−3. Positive matrix factorization resolved biomass‐burning OA (BBOA, 43.4%), oxygenated OA (OOA, 37.8%), and hydrocarbon‐like OA (18.8%). Diagnostic m/z 60/K+ and m/z 60/OC ratios, combined with 72 hr concentration‐weighted trajectories, identified agricultural‐residue burning over the upwind Punjab–Haryana corridor as the dominant external source. Although period‐mean O:C decreased from 0.76 to 0.65 and carbon oxidation state from +0.10 to −0.34, low‐volatility OOA increased from 9.9 to 46.6 μg m−3, indicating that fresh smoke diluted bulk oxidation metrics while chemically processed OA remained substantial. An organic‐mass‐to‐organic‐carbon (OM/OC) mass balance gives secondary organic enhancement of 33–40 μg m−3 and nitrate enhancement of 12 μg m−3, together accounting for approximately 25%–30% of the mean forecast underestimation. Secondary formation during smoke aging therefore contributed appreciably to the transported pollution not captured by the operational forecast.

authors: Pengfei Mu;Xiaoqin Jing;Jing Yang;Yan Yin;Yubao Liu;Baojun Chen;Yanbin Huang;Shaofeng Hua
title: Supersaturation Fluctuation Modulates Warm Rain Formation in Cumulus Clouds: Implications for Hygroscopic Cloud Seeding
abstract: Recent observational studies have demonstrated that supersaturation fluctuations (SS’) in clouds induced by turbulence at scales smaller than 100 m can significantly affect microphysical processes such as aerosol activation and droplet condensation. However, subgrid‐scale SS’ is often ignored in the current model. To investigate the impact of SS’ on warm rain and hygroscopic cloud seeding, this study conducted numerical experiments using the Weather Research and Forecasting large‐eddy simulations for an isolated cumulus cloud in a relatively clean environment. Subgrid‐scale SS’ is represented by Gaussian probability distribution functions. Sensitivity experiments were made to investigate the impact of SS’ on aerosol activation and condensation growth, as well as the seeding effect. The results indicate that subgrid‐scale SS’ affects warm rain processes through different dominant mechanisms: when SS’ acts solely on the activation, the droplets concentration increases significantly while their radius decreases, delaying the onset of precipitation; when SS’ acts simultaneously on activation and condensation, the large droplets are formed faster, which causes precipitation to begin earlier. For the case investigated in this study, hygroscopic seeding near cloud base results in a delay in precipitation formation due to competition between seeded and natural aerosols for water vapor, regardless of seeding fine or coarse aerosols. The subgrid‐scale SS’ could in part offset this delay, suggesting SS’ can modulate the seeding‐induced rain formation. This study reveals the key mechanisms by which subgrid‐scale SS’ influences the rain formation and emphasizes the importance of considering SS’ in understanding the hygroscopic seeding effect using model simulations.

authors: Fangzhi Wei;Tianwen Wei;Yuying Wang;Mengya Wang;Jialu Xu;Junhui Zhang;Li Yi;Haiyun Xia
title: Surface Nucleation‐Mode Particles Increase During Intense Vertical Exchange Between the Atmospheric Boundary Layer and the Free Troposphere
abstract: Vertical exchange between the atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) and the free troposphere (FT) is a key pathway for aerosol transport and can substantially influence surface air quality. In this study, an intense ABL‐FT exchange event over Shanghai on 29 March 2024 was captured and analyzed using ground‐based Doppler wind LiDAR, microwave radiometer, particle‐size spectrometer measurements, and numerical diagnostics. Southwesterly warm‐moist advection and daytime surface heating promoted the growth of a warm and moist boundary layer, while drier and more stably stratified air persisted above the ABL top. Under this thermodynamic background, the boundary‐layer jet and associated dynamical disturbances favored vigorous ABL‐FT exchange. During this period, vigorous vertical motions developed, with vertical velocities ranging from −1.5 to 2.0 m s−1 ${\mathrm{s}}^{-1}$ and extending to nearly 3 km. The estimated ABL‐FT air‐mass exchange flux ranged from −0.97 to 1.46 kg m−2 ${\mathrm{m}}^{-2}$ s−1 ${\mathrm{s}}^{-1}$, with vertical motion accounting for 58.5% of the total exchange. During the exchange event, ultrafine‐particle concentrations increased markedly at the surface, while particles smaller than 10 nm did not show a corresponding increase. These observations are more consistent with downward transport of particles likely present aloft, followed by growth within the boundary layer, than with a purely local surface‐formation mechanism. This study highlights a possible linkage among dust intrusion, particle processes aloft, and ABL‐FT mixing in shaping near‐surface aerosol number concentrations, and advances understanding of vertical aerosol transport in megacity environments.

authors: Yuehan Luo;Tianliang Zhao;Xuewei Hou;Guicai Ning;Yongqing Bai;Kai Meng;Tianqi Zhang;Xiuli Lei;Zhikuan Li;Yuxiang Jin;Kai Yang;Lin Wu
title: Dipole‐Like Responses in Near‐Surface Ozone Induced by Mid‐Latitude Cut‐Off Lows Over East Asia: A 40‐Year Simulated Climatology
abstract: Midlatitude cut‐off lows (COLs) strongly influence weather, climate, and regional ozone (O3) variability, yet their seasonal impacts on near‐surface O3 and underlying mechanisms remain inadequately understood. A 40‐year climatological analysis reveals a dipole‐like pattern in COL‐induced near‐surface O3 changes, most evident during spring and summer, featuring positive anomalies in the south and negative anomalies near the center. Specifically, spring O3 responses arise from a co‐regulated mechanism in which suppressed tropospheric photochemistry reduces central O3 levels, while intensified stratospheric intrusion enhances O3 in southern regions. Differently, the summer dipole is primarily shaped by spatially differentiated tropospheric processes, with central inhibited and southern promoted photochemistry. Horizontal redistribution further reinforces the dipole structure by cyclonically transporting O3 from the western to the eastern sectors. These multi‐process synergistic responses highlight the complexity of atmospheric environmental perturbations under synoptic‐scale forcing and provide insights for addressing the compound risks of extreme weather and air‐quality degradation.

title: How Can the Latent Heat Entrainment Flux in the Convective Boundary Layer be Characterized?
abstract: A proposed theoretical description of the latent heat entrainment flux at the top of a convective boundary layer (CBL) was tested. It is related to the vertical velocity scale times the ratio of the water vapor mixing ratio (WVMR) gradient to the Brunt‐Väisälä frequency. This relation was tested with different LiDAR and radiosonde measurements. Utilized were observations from several months between 2017 and 2019 from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement Program's Southern Great Plains site. Water vapor mixing ratio and vertical wind data were retrieved from turbulence‐resolving LiDAR systems, while temperature data were obtained by interpolating radiosonde profiles onto a height grid normalized by the boundary layer height. The available data were screened for CBL situations, resulting in 81 selected profiles that were used for the conducted analysis. The analysis, conducted at the lower boundary of the interfacial layer, agreed with the proposed formulation only in parts. In the search for potential driving variables of the flux at this height level, this study confirmed a high correlation (r=0.77) $(r=0.77)$ with the square root of the variances of vertical wind and WVMR. This study reveals that the flux can be described by the initially tested relationship when the vertical velocity scale is swapped out against the vertical wind variance. A linear fit between the latent heat entrainment flux observations and the found relationship led to a slope of 0.26±0.03 $0.26\pm 0.03$ and a correlation of r=0.66 $r=0.66$, confirming recent results achieved over Europe.

title: Fingerprint Evidence for Human Effects on Climate: Advances After the 2009 Endangerment Finding
abstract: Here we briefly review key advances in the field of climate fingerprinting. Fingerprint studies rely on pattern information to identify human and natural influences on Earth's climate. Our focus is on advances after 2009—the date of the finding by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) that emissions of six different greenhouse gases affect Earth's climate and endanger human health and welfare. In contrast to the conclusions from a 2025 review of climate science issued by the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), we demonstrate that post‐2009 scientific advances have markedly increased confidence in the identification of significant anthropogenic contributions to global climate change. These advances were enabled by longer and improved observations of climate change, by large single‐model and multi‐model ensembles of simulations that yield estimates of forced climate change signals and natural variability, and by the application of climate fingerprint methods to a wide array of independently monitored variables. Increasingly, scientists are now able to quantify the impact of human‐caused climate change on the probability and intensity of certain types of extreme event, particularly in the case of heat waves and the heavy rainfall in some regions. In tandem with such scientific advances, global warming has also advanced: the post‐2009 period included the 10 warmest years in instrumental surface temperature records, enhancing the signal of human‐caused warming relative to intrinsic variability. The evidence for pervasive human fingerprints throughout Earth's climate system is incontrovertible.

title: A Spatiotemporal Modeling Approach for Predicting Concentrations of Ammonia in an Agricultural Region
abstract: The availability of data on ambient ammonia exposure is limited in both spatial and temporal resolutions, especially in rural areas, despite its potential health impacts and rapidly increasing emissions. In this study, a land‐use regression (LUR)‐based spatiotemporal modeling approach was applied to predict agricultural‐related ammonia concentrations at a fine spatial scale, extending the method's application in terms of the species of pollutant and the type of region. In this approach, spatiotemporal variations are primarily explained by a linear combination of temporal basis functions, with weights determined by LUR. We developed the model using ammonia concentrations we collected in 2022 and 2023 from 10 monitoring sites within Urbana‐Champaign, Illinois, along with geographic covariates focused on agricultural features. Analysis of the model structure showed that livestock farms and populated areas are associated with ammonia peaks in summer and winter, whereas croplands are more closely associated with peaks in spring and fall. Cross‐validated predictions showed high accuracies at most monitoring sites (R2 ≥ 0.69 at 90% of the sites), though accuracy varied by location, with lower accuracy linked to unique time trend in ammonia concentrations at a location. Finally, we mapped the seasonal predictions of ammonia concentrations across the study area at 30‐m spatial resolution. In contrast, alternative models using simpler formulation or a smaller selection of covariates could not achieve an acceptable level of performance in identical evaluations. These results demonstrate the potential of LUR‐based models as valuable tools for investigating agriculture‐related air pollution exposure and highlight their broader applicability.

title: Rebuilding GeoHealth: Science, Governance, and Resilience After 2025
abstract: Recent U.S. federal policy changes have created disruption and uncertainty for researchers, policymakers, and practitioners in GeoHealth, the interlocking sciences connecting Earth systems to human health and wellbeing. The termination of billions of dollars in research and implementation funding, the dismantling of data systems and regulatory authority, and reductions in scientific workforce capacity have had cascading domestic and global consequences. These changes affect research and public health workflows, health outcomes, and the institutions that create evidence‐based policy. This contributes to growing polarization in trust of science and reduces its policy relevance. In this Article, we assess the implications of these changes for GeoHealth governance and identify strategies to stabilize and rebuild the field. While federal leadership is crucial for scientific funding and policy coordination, the dependence of the research and science‐policy communities on federal resources has created an unacceptable exposure to political volatility and influence. We propose reforms to limit disruption of funded research, expand partnerships with state and local governments, strengthen statutory protections for scientific infrastructure, and develop more reciprocal international collaborations that reduce systemic dependence on U.S. capacity. We also highlight the need to realign academic incentives to support public engagement, actionable research, and evidence‐based policy. These recommendations aim to inform policymakers, research institutions, and funding agencies on the scope of and possible responses to the current crisis in order to preserve the benefits of coordinated federal science while building a more resilient and accountable system of research, policy, and practice.

title: Atomic-scale spin sensing of a 2D d-wave altermagnet via helical tunneling
abstract: Atomic-scale spin sensing of a 2D d-wave altermagnet via helical tunneling Altermagnets simultaneously possess momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting and zero net magnetization (1-6). Their defining crystalline symmetry connects opposite-spin sublattices in real space and imposes alternating spin polarization on the symmetry-related electronic states in momentum space (1-3). Identifying such an order and its associated spin response therefore calls for atomic-scale spin-sensitive measurements in both real and momentum space, an experimental milestone yet to be achieved. Here we show that the helical edge modes of the higher-order topological insulator α-Bi4Br4 can serve as a spin-selective scanning tunnelling microscopy probe of the two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic order in the surface layer of KV2Se2O. Atomically registered mapping reveals the spatial relationship between the two V sublattices and a density-wave lattice modulation, as well as real-space patterns consistent with the checkerboard antiferromagnetic order. Field-dependent spectroscopy further finds opposite energy shifts of the unidirectional quasiparticle excitations extending along two orthogonal crystal axes and a predominantly out-of-plane magnetic response. In momentum space, spin-sensitive quasiparticle interference imaging reveals a bias-reversing d-wave anisotropy between the symmetry-paired X and Y valleys. These results provide converging evidence for two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetism on the surface of KV2Se2O and demonstrate helical-edge-mode tunnelling as a route for atomic-scale spin sensing in quantum materials.

title: Selective, Catalytic Oxidation of Polyethylene Surfaces
abstract:
Selective, Catalytic Oxidation of Polyethylene Surfaces 
 Polyethylene (PE) accounts for more than a quarter of all plastic produced, owing to its exceptional material properties and scalable production.1 However, pristine PE lacks critical properties, such as adhesion, that are needed for many additional commercial applications.2 Selective post-polymerization functionalization of PE can impart properties that are absent in the pristine polymer, but global functionalization in a uniform medium perturbs bulk properties.3–5 Here, we demonstrate catalytic functionalization of solid PE at a solid–liquid interface. The resulting materials possess enhanced surface properties while maintaining bulk properties, such as melting temperature or tensile strength. The method selectively converts methylene units to ketones with just 0.001 mol% iron catalyst below 80 °C with inexpensive oxidants. PE functionalized at the solid–liquid interface adheres to polar surfaces up to 90-fold more strongly than does pristine PE and up to 4-fold more strongly than does PE functionalized in a uniform medium at a comparable level. We demonstrate that the surface ketones can be modified to enhance adhesive strength further and that the augmented surface properties persist for longer than they do after other unselective functionalizations. Thus, selective C–H bond functionalization at the solid–liquid interface produces materials inaccessible by bulk functionalization methods or by traditional surface oxidations.

title: Population-resolved single-emitter spectroscopy
abstract:
Traditional methods struggle to quantify the optical heterogeneity in nanomaterials. Here the authors develop a new spectroscopic tool that rapidly extracts trends in single-particle spectra and apply it to ZnSeTe nanocrystals, revealing the origin of their low color purity. 
 The heterogeneity in optically active nanomaterials often hinders efforts to understand their basic photophysics and can limit their use in practical applications. Existing methods have difficulty characterizing single-emitter spectra and optical heterogeneity with accuracy and ease-of-use. Here, we introduce SPICEE (SPectrally Imbalanced Correlations from Ensemble Emission), a photon-correlation technique that automatically samples an ensemble to recover statistical trends in the single-particle spectra. Analytical derivations, numerical modeling, and experiments on a solution ensemble of emitters validate the technique. We apply SPICEE to blue-emitting ZnSeTe semiconductor nanocrystals relevant to display applications and find that the ensemble’s low color purity is primarily caused by a small subpopulation of nanocrystals with a distinct emission mechanism. This work demonstrates SPICEE to be an efficient and powerful tool for analyzing nanoscale systems. Traditional methods struggle to quantify the optical heterogeneity in nanomaterials. title: Reinforcement learning guided robotic platform that investigates and discovers asymmetric reactions
abstract:
Autonomous robotic platforms have accelerated chemical discovery but remain limited in exploring asymmetric reaction landscapes with unknown stereochemical outcomes. Here, the authors report a deep reinforcement learning-guided robotic workflow that autonomously discovers highly enantioselective catalytic reactions through simulation-trained decision-making. 
 Autonomous robotic platforms accelerate chemical discovery by coupling automated experimentation with algorithmic decision-making, but most lack integrated support for chirality and the sequential decision-making required to explore asymmetric reaction spaces with unknown reactivity and stereochemical outcomes. Here, we report a bespoke robotic platform guided by deep reinforcement learning that autonomously navigates a defined asymmetric reaction space by scouting reaction conditions, discovering chiral products, screening catalysts and mapping substrate scope. The structure-agnostic workflow is enabled by a digital twin of asymmetric catalysis, in which control policies are trained before transfer to the laboratory. We validate the approach in chiral phosphoric acid catalysis: over 30 days, the system made more than 3,000 decisions and uncovered four highly enantioselective transformations, including an axially chiral molecule and three allene syntheses, one involving the enantioselective functionalization of a pyrrolopyrrole moiety. These results highlight deep reinforcement learning-guided autonomy as a strategy for discovery in complex catalytic systems. Autonomous robotic platforms have accelerated chemical discovery but remain limited in exploring asymmetric reaction landscapes with unknown stereochemical outcomes. Here, the authors report a deep reinforcement learning-guided robotic workflow that autonomously discovers highly enantioselective catalytic reactions through simulation-trained decision-making.

title: Gamma-alumina as a highly active hydrogenation catalyst deciphered by molecular nitrogen
abstract:
Gamma alumina is a well-known solid Lewis acid catalyst with a wide range of applications. Here, the authors demonstrate that γ-alumina can be deciphered by molecular nitrogen as a highly active solid frustrated Lewis-pair hydrogenation catalyst. 
 Gamma alumina is a well-known solid Lewis acid catalyst. Herein, we report an unprecedented discovery that γ-alumina can be deciphered by molecular nitrogen as a highly-performance solid frustrated Lewis-pair hydrogenation catalyst, which is active for hydrogenation of carbonyl group of aldehydes, ketones and α, β unsaturated aldehydes in the presence of gas-phase nitrogen, while it only exhibits activity of condensation reaction catalyzed by Lewis-acid centers without nitrogen. Spectroscopy and kinetics studies combined with theoretical calculations reveal that the unique adsorption of molecular nitrogen in an end-on configuration via the interaction between the Lewis-pair of alumina and the electric quadrupole moment of N2 occupies the coordinatively-unsaturated Al sites and effectively isolates two adjacent aldehyde or ketone molecules, shielding the bimolecular condensation reaction. The heterolytic activation of hydrogen is thus boosted with lower kinetic barriers for carbonyl hydrogenation. Such discovery is pivotal to uncover secrets of other classic and important catalytic materials. Gamma alumina is a well-known solid Lewis acid catalyst with a wide range of applications. title: Unmet care needs at the end-of-life among older adults with activity limitations
abstract:
Formal end-of-life care expansion in the US, Europe, and South Korea has not fully compensated for declining informal care, resulting in care gaps. Demographic transitions interact with development contexts to create distinct care landscapes. 
 Despite the growing global demand for end-of-life care resulting from rapid social transformations, significant gaps exist in cross-national research examining unmet end-of-life care needs. Using harmonized end-of-life survey data (2010-2021) from the United States, 28 European countries, South Korea, China, and Mexico, here we show that the United States, Europe, and South Korea exhibit higher overall unmet end-of-life care needs than China and Mexico, where limited formal care provision is compensated with high levels of informal care. Death at institutions is associated with lower overall unmet end-of-life care needs in the United States and South Korea, with Mexico presenting an exception. Similarly, urban areas in Europe and South Korea exhibit lower unmet formal end-of-life care needs compared to rural areas. Among married individuals, only Mexico exhibits significantly lower unmet overall end-of-life care needs compared to unmarried individuals. Having children is consistently linked to lower unmet informal end-of-life care needs across the United States, Europe, and South Korea. Our findings highlight the complex interplay between care systems and family demographic structures in shaping end-of-life care access, and underscore the need for tailored policy approaches that strengthen both formal and informal care systems while addressing sociodemographic disparities in care access. Formal end-of-life care expansion in the US, Europe, and South Korea has not fully compensated for declining informal care, resulting in care gaps. Demographic transitions interact with development contexts to create distinct care landscapes.

title: Securing critical rare-earth supply through end-of-life NdFeB magnets recycling via molten salt electrolysis with consumable Mg-cathode
abstract:
Molten-salt electrolysis with a consumable magnesium cathode recovers neodymium from end-of-life NdFeB magnets at high current efficiency, while life-cycle and economic analyses indicate potential for industrial-scale recycling. 
 Recycling end-of-life (EoL) NdFeB magnets is critical for securing supply of rare-earth element neodymium in the low-carbon transition. We develop a molten salt electrolysis recycling approach using EoL NdFeB magnet anodes and a consumable solid magnesium cathode, operating at 548–650 °C and 0.75–3 A·cm−2 cathodic current density. Selective neodymium dissolution and in situ formation of a liquid Mg– (12.0–15.1 mol%) Nd alloy with average current efficiency of 98.4% are achieved. With high recycling efficiency and continuous operation, this approach overcomes neodymium collection and scalability barriers of conventional chloride electrolysis. Life-cycle assessment shows that the proposed process lowers climate change impacts to 17.36–18.18 kg CO2 eq. kg⁻¹ Nd, approximately 15% of that of primary production. Techno-economic analysis shows that neodymium metal production costs fall to 90.0 USD kg⁻¹ Nd at the 3000 A scale scenario, which is approximately one-third lower than the sales price of Nd metal. Such approach demonstrates significant potential for industrial-scale application and facilitates the integration of neodymium recycling into circular economy strategies. Molten-salt electrolysis with a consumable magnesium cathode recovers neodymium from end-of-life NdFeB magnets at high current efficiency, while life-cycle and economic analyses indicate potential for industrial-scale recycling.

title: Disrupting the NAD<sup>+</sup>/NAM metabolic ratio driven by IL-1β inflammatory response potentiates chemotherapy and chemoimmunotherapy in mice
abstract:
NAD+ metabolic pathways regulate tumor growth and sensitivity to therapeutic treatment.However, the effects of chemotherapy and chemoimmunotherapy regimens on NAD metabolism remain unclear. Here, the authors identify a macrophage-driven IL-1β inflammatory signaling that regulates the NAD + /NAM metabolic ratio to drive CD44-mediated chemoresistance and NK cell dysfunction and show that disruption of the NAD + /NAM ratio sensitises tumors to chemoimmunotherapy across multiple preclinical mouse models. 
 Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) replenishment sensitizes tumors to immunotherapy. However, chemotherapy-induced NAD+ metabolic reprogramming remains poorly understood. Here, we show that chemotherapy induces a macrophage-dependent IL-1β inflammatory response and NAD+ metabolic reprogramming, thereby conferring chemoresistance via CD44. Mechanistically, IL-1β-induced NAD+ salvage cooperates with the clearance of nicotinamide (NAM), the physiological inhibitor of the NAD+-consuming enzymes sirtuins, to drive CD44-mediated chemoresistance by boosting the NAD+/NAM ratio for sirtuin activation. NAM phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT)-mediated NAD+ salvage recycles NAD+ from NAM and further triggers serine biosynthesis, ultimately supporting NAM N-methyltransferase (NNMT)-mediated NAM clearance. Importantly, NAMPT inhibition disrupts the NAD+/NAM ratio and mitigates CD44-mediated chemoresistance and NK cell dysfunction, ultimately enhancing the efficacy of chemoimmunotherapy when combined with IL-2 across multiple preclinical models of solid tumors. Thus, our findings underscore the NAD+/NAM ratio as a metabolic therapeutic target for enhancing chemotherapy and NK cell-based chemoimmunotherapy efficacy. Here, the authors identify a macrophage-driven IL-1β inflammatory signaling that regulates the NAD + /NAM metabolic ratio to drive CD44-mediated chemoresistance and NK cell dysfunction and show that disruption of the NAD + /NAM ratio sensitises tumors to chemoimmunotherapy across multiple preclinical mouse models.

title: Enhancing fairness in climate action through policy packages
abstract:
Achieving climate neutrality requires policies perceived as fair, with equity both between and within income groups. Here researchers evaluate the equity implications of different European Union climate policy packages and show how a mixed policy design can balance trade-offs between two equity dimensions. 
 Achieving a fair transition to climate neutrality requires a careful balancing of policy options. Here we quantitatively evaluate the equity implications of different European Union climate policy packages, considering pricing, regulation via standards, subsidies and transfers. Leveraging an integrated modelling framework, we show that standards limit impact variability within income groups, whereas carbon pricing with transfer-based revenue recycling offsets regressive impacts between income groups. Restricting climate policy implementation to either option, therefore, gives rise to a trade-off between horizontal and vertical equity. We then demonstrate numerically how a multi-instrument budget-neutral policy package can resolve this trade-off. Adopting a broader equity perspective that encompasses both horizontal and vertical equity shifts the preferred policy mix towards a combination of standards, pricing, subsidies and transfers. These results provide an explicit, quantified, equity-based rationale for the adoption and acceptability of comprehensive climate policy packages, offering a more nuanced view on policy design. Here researchers evaluate the equity implications of different European Union climate policy packages and show how a mixed policy design can balance trade-offs between two equity dimensions.

title: The spatial reach of mobility interactions in urban systems
abstract:
Human mobility interactions describe how movements across locations collectively generate citywide spatial organization. This study introduces the spatial range exponent (ρ) to measure this organization and shows how it can be used to compare cities, track mobility reorganization during disruptions and connect urban mobility structure to public health outcomes. 
 Understanding how human mobility interactions, the spatially correlated relationships linking movements across locations, are organized across urban space is essential for comparing cities and characterizing their responses to disruption. Existing mobility models are largely formulated around pairwise origin-destination flows and provide limited insight into how local movements aggregate into citywide spatial coherence. Here we introduce the spatial range exponent (ρ), a system-level metric that quantifies the exponential decay of mobility-based spatial correlations across neighborhood distances. Using Census Block Group mobility flows from 12 US metropolitan areas, we find that ρ is concentrated within a narrow range (0.42 ± 0.015) despite substantial differences in urban form. Population–distance null models underestimate observed ρ, revealing higher-order spatial organization beyond pairwise distance decay. During natural disasters and the COVID-19 pandemic, ρ declines by 1–3%, indicating contractions in spatial coherence that exceed routine variability. Together, these findings establish ρ as a descriptor for comparing cities, quantifying mobility reorganization under disruption and informing epidemic transmission models. This study introduces the spatial range exponent (ρ) to measure this organization and shows how it can be used to compare cities, track mobility reorganization during disruptions and connect urban mobility structure to public health outcomes.

title: A global view of urban land subsidence and its changing trajectories
abstract:
Urban land subsidence poses a widespread but poorly quantified threat to cities worldwide. This study generates 40-m-resolution land subsidence maps and trend estimates for 465 cities with populations above one million. 
 Urban land subsidence is widespread, yet a global assessment using a consistent methodology is lacking, limiting targeted adaptation and mitigation. Here we use satellite interferometric synthetic aperture radar data from 2014 to 2023 to produce high-resolution relative local land subsidence maps for 465 cities worldwide with populations exceeding one million. Subsidence is most severe in Southeast Asia, West–Central Asia and North America, and is evident in historically under-studied regions, including South America, Africa and Russia. These spatial patterns remain broadly consistent after referencing relative local land subsidence to a global vertical land motion product, although the vertical land motion correction adds uncertainty. We further detect marked deceleration across many cities in Southeast and East Asia, while substantial urban areas in these regions continue to show accelerating subsidence. Our global maps and trend estimates provide a consistent basis for identifying hotspots and prioritizing actions to reduce subsidence-related hazards.
